title: 托业通勤听力扩充词库（第二批，原创）
disclaimer: 本词库与录音均为原创托业/商务英语学习材料，不是新东方或其他商业词书的原文或录音。

entries.en: Please submit the bid before Friday's deadline.
entries.zh: 请在周五的截止日期前提交投标。

entries.en: The CEO's announcement about the merger will be posted on the intranet.
entries.zh: 首席执行官关于合并的公告将发布在内网上。

entries.en: A safety bulletin was circulated after the warehouse inspection.
entries.zh: 仓库检查结束后，公司传阅了一份安全简报。

entries.en: You will receive an email notification when the invoice is approved.
entries.zh: 发票获批后，你会收到一封电子邮件通知。

entries.en: The postponement of the product launch was caused by a parts shortage.
entries.zh: 产品发布推迟是因为零件短缺。

entries.en: Her resignation takes effect at the end of the notice period.
entries.zh: 她的辞职将在通知期结束时生效。

entries.en: Overseas revenue now accounts for nearly half of annual sales.
entries.zh: 海外营收目前已接近全年销售额的一半。

entries.en: Please return any defective units within fourteen days of delivery.
entries.zh: 请在到货十四天内退回任何有缺陷的产品。

entries.en: The conference center handles catering for all plenary lunches.
entries.zh: 会议中心负责所有全体会议午餐的餐饮服务。

entries.en: The new floor plan requires additional furniture for the open workspace.
entries.zh: 新的平面图需要为开放办公区添置家具。

entries.en: The copier on the third floor is out of toner again.
entries.zh: 三楼的复印机又没碳粉了。

entries.en: Please leave the stapler and spare staples at the reception desk.
entries.zh: 请把订书机和备用订书钉放在前台。

entries.en: Confidential drafts should go into the shredder, not the recycling bin.
entries.zh: 机密草稿应放入碎纸机，不要丢进回收箱。

entries.en: The inspector carried a clipboard to record warehouse temperatures.
entries.zh: 检查员拿着写字夹板记录仓库温度。

entries.en: Each trainee will shadow a senior associate for the first month.
entries.zh: 每位实习生第一个月都将跟随一名资深同事见习。

entries.meaning: 自由职业者；兼职创作者
entries.en: We hired a freelancer to redesign the product brochure.
entries.zh: 我们请了一位自由职业者重新设计产品手册。

entries.en: Outsourcing payroll has reduced our administrative workload.
entries.zh: 把工资核算外包后，我们的行政工作量减轻了。

entries.en: The board is considering insourcing customer support next year.
entries.zh: 董事会正在考虑明年把客户支持收回自营。

entries.en: The general contractor must ensure every subcontractor carries insurance.
entries.zh: 总包商必须确保每位分包商都有保险。

entries.en: The wholesaler can deliver pallets to regional stores within two days.
entries.zh: 该批发商可在两天内把整托货物送到区域门店。

entries.en: The retailer asked for a lower wholesale price on the holiday collection.
entries.zh: 这家零售商要求下调节日系列的批发价。

entries.en: Do not use the photographs until the copyright transfer is signed.
entries.zh: 在版权转让文件签署前，请勿使用这些照片。

entries.en: The letter alleges infringement of the company's registered trademark.
entries.zh: 该函声称对方侵犯了公司的注册商标。

entries.en: Both parties reached a settlement before the hearing began.
entries.zh: 双方在听证会开始前达成了和解。

entries.en: Detailed cost breakdowns appear in the appendix of the proposal.
entries.zh: 详细的成本明细列在提案附录中。

entries.en: All interns must sign a confidentiality agreement on their first day.
entries.zh: 所有实习生必须在入职第一天签署保密协议。

entries.en: Please notarize the power of attorney before mailing it to the bank.
entries.zh: 请将授权书公证后再寄给银行。

entries.en: The quality manager must certify that each batch meets the specification.
entries.zh: 质量经理必须证明每一批次都符合规格。

entries.en: Two witnesses must attest to the director's signature on the deed.
entries.zh: 必须有两名见证人证明董事在契据上的签字。

entries.en: The amortization of the software license is spread over three years.
entries.zh: 该软件许可的摊销分三年进行。

entries.en: Please send the receipts to the accountant by Monday morning.
entries.zh: 请在周一上午前把收据交给会计。

entries.en: The accounting team closes the books on the fifth business day.
entries.zh: 会计团队在第五个工作日完成结账。

entries.en: The job advertisement will run in the trade journal for two weeks.
entries.zh: 这则招聘广告将在行业期刊上刊登两周。

entries.en: Our advertising budget for the product launch has been approved.
entries.zh: 产品发布的广告预算已经获批。

entries.en: A tax advisor will review the overseas subsidiary's filings.
entries.zh: 税务顾问将审核海外子公司的申报材料。

entries.en: An advisory committee will recommend a new travel policy.
entries.zh: 顾问委员会将建议一项新的差旅政策。

entries.en: The airline offered a later flight after our connection was cancelled.
entries.zh: 衔接航班取消后，航空公司为我们安排了较晚的航班。

entries.en: The cargo aircraft can carry the oversized machinery in one shipment.
entries.zh: 这架货运飞机可以一次运走超大机械设备。

entries.en: Please report any air-conditioning problems to building maintenance.
entries.zh: 如空调出现问题，请向楼宇维修部门报告。

entries.en: Bring a calculator to the budget workshop on Thursday.
entries.zh: 周四的预算研讨请带上计算器。

entries.en: The receptionist will issue visitor badges in the lobby.
entries.zh: 前台接待员将在大厅发放访客证。

entries.en: Guests should wait in the lobby until their host arrives.
entries.zh: 访客应在大厅等候接待人到来。

entries.en: The departure lounge has power outlets near every seating area.
entries.zh: 出发休息室每个座位区附近都有电源插座。

entries.en: Fire exits at both ends of the hallway must remain clear.
entries.zh: 走廊两端的消防出口必须保持畅通。

entries.en: The restroom on this floor is temporarily closed for maintenance.
entries.zh: 本层洗手间因维修暂时关闭。

entries.en: Please put the signed contracts in the blue folder on my desk.
entries.zh: 请把已签字的合同放进我桌上的蓝色文件夹。

entries.en: Use a highlighter to mark revised clauses in the contract.
entries.zh: 请用荧光笔标出合同中修订过的条款。

entries.en: The network printer is offline until the technician replaces the drum.
entries.zh: 在技术员更换硒鼓之前，网络打印机将处于脱机状态。

entries.en: If email is down, fax the purchase order to the supplier.
entries.zh: 如果电子邮件无法使用，请把采购订单传真给供应商。

entries.en: Please check your inbox for the revised travel itinerary.
entries.zh: 请查看收件箱中的修订版行程。

entries.en: The message is still in the outbox because the server is busy.
entries.zh: 由于服务器繁忙，该邮件仍在发件箱中。

entries.en: The price list is in the attachment, not in the body of the email.
entries.zh: 价目表在附件里，不在邮件正文中。

entries.en: Please cc the project sponsor on all budget change requests.
entries.zh: 所有预算变更申请请抄送项目发起人。

entries.en: Use bcc when writing to a large group of external guests.
entries.zh: 给大批外部来宾写信时请使用密送。

entries.en: A clear subject-line helps the finance team file the request quickly.
entries.zh: 清晰的主题行有助于财务团队迅速归档申请。

entries.en: Please keep the discussion in the same email thread.
entries.zh: 请把讨论留在同一封邮件对话串里。

entries.en: Avoid reply-all unless everyone on the copy list needs the update.
entries.zh: 除非抄送名单上的每个人都需要了解进展，否则不要全部回复。

entries.en: A circular was sent to all branches about the holiday opening hours.
entries.zh: 已向各分店发出关于节日营业时间的通函。

entries.en: Please put a stack of flyers next to the registration desk.
entries.zh: 请在登记台旁边放一叠传单。

entries.en: A safety leaflet is included with every power tool.
entries.zh: 每件电动工具都附有一份安全说明单页。

entries.en: Please seal the confidential papers in a plain envelope.
entries.zh: 请把机密文件装进空白信封并封好。

entries.en: Overnight postage for the samples will be billed to the client.
entries.zh: 样品的隔夜邮资将向客户收取。

entries.en: Checks should be dropped in the locked mailbox by the finance office.
entries.zh: 支票请投入财务办公室旁上锁的信箱。

entries.en: The postage-meter needs a new ink cartridge before the mailing.
entries.zh: 这次邮寄前，邮资机需要更换墨盒。

entries.en: Send the original certificates by registered-mail, not by regular post.
entries.zh: 原件证书请用挂号邮件寄送，不要用普通平邮。

entries.en: The termination notice was sent by certified-mail with a return receipt.
entries.zh: 解约通知已通过保证邮件寄出，并要求回执。

entries.en: Request a return-receipt so we can confirm the client received the contract.
entries.zh: 请索取回执，以便确认客户已收到合同。

entries.en: Please send me the tracking-number as soon as the shipment leaves the warehouse.
entries.zh: 货物一离开仓库，请立刻把运单号发给我。

entries.en: The driver cannot unload the goods without a signed waybill.
entries.zh: 没有已签字的运单，司机不能卸货。

entries.en: The air-waybill number is required for the customs declaration.
entries.zh: 办理报关需要航空运单号。

entries.en: A packing-slip should be placed in each carton.
entries.zh: 每个纸箱里都应放入一张装箱单。

entries.en: Please have the supervisor sign the delivery-note on arrival.
entries.zh: 货物到达时请主管在送货单上签字。

entries.en: The sales-order was revised after the customer changed the quantity.
entries.zh: 客户更改数量后，销售订单已修订。

entries.en: The warehouse sent a debit-note for the additional storage days.
entries.zh: 仓库就额外仓储天数发来了借记通知。

entries.en: Customs requires a commercial-invoice that matches the packing list.
entries.zh: 海关要求商业发票与装箱单一致。

entries.en: Three vendors were invited to respond to the request-for-proposal.
entries.zh: 三家供应商获邀回应这份提案征询书。

entries.en: Anything outside the agreed scope-of-work will be billed separately.
entries.zh: 超出约定工作范围的部分将另行计费。

entries.en: Please sign the non-disclosure-agreement before we share the prototype.
entries.zh: 在我们分享原型之前，请先签署保密协议。

entries.en: The service-level-agreement requires a four-hour response to critical faults.
entries.zh: 服务级别协议要求对严重故障在四小时内响应。

entries.en: Candidates should attach a one-page cover-letter to the application form.
entries.zh: 应聘者应在申请表上附上一页求职信。

entries.en: He will take two weeks of paternity-leave after the baby's arrival.
entries.zh: 孩子出生后，他将休两周陪产假。

entries.en: Please enter your annual-leave dates in the HR system this week.
entries.zh: 请在本周把年假日期录入人力资源系统。

entries.en: Staff who worked the public holiday will receive compensatory-leave.
entries.zh: 在公共假期加班的员工将获得调休。

entries.en: The coordinator role is now filled through job-sharing by two part-time staff.
entries.zh: 协调员一职目前由两名兼职员工分担。

entries.en: The night-shift supervisor handles all inbound shipments after 10 p.m.
entries.zh: 夜班主管负责晚上十点后的所有进货。

entries.en: Overtime-pay is calculated at one and a half times the regular hourly rate.
entries.zh: 加班费按正常时薪的1.5倍计算。

entries.en: Sunday work is paid at time-and-a-half under the current contract.
entries.zh: 根据现行合同，周日工作按一倍半工资支付。

entries.en: Public-holiday shifts are paid at double-time.
entries.zh: 公共假期班次按双倍工资支付。

entries.en: Severance-pay will be transferred within ten business days of the last working day.
entries.zh: 遣散费将在最后工作日后的十个工作日内转入账户。

entries.en: The payroll correction includes two months of back-pay.
entries.zh: 这次工资更正包含两个月的补发工资。

entries.en: Health-insurance coverage begins on the first day of the month after hiring.
entries.zh: 医疗保险从入职后次月1日开始生效。

entries.en: The company provides basic life-insurance at no cost to employees.
entries.zh: 公司为员工提供免费的基本人寿保险。

entries.en: Dental-insurance claims should be filed within 60 days of treatment.
entries.zh: 牙科保险理赔应在治疗后60天内提交。

entries.en: Disability-insurance may replace part of your income during a long absence.
entries.zh: 长期病假期间，伤残保险可补偿部分收入。

entries.en: Report the injury immediately so the workers-compensation claim can be filed.
entries.zh: 请立即报告受伤情况，以便申请工伤赔偿。

entries.en: Travel-insurance is required for all overseas assignments longer than three days.
entries.zh: 所有超过三天的海外出差都必须购买旅行保险。

entries.en: Venue rental is not confirmed until liability-insurance documents are received.
entries.zh: 在收到责任保险文件之前，场地租赁不能确认。

entries.en: The agency's booking-fee is shown as a separate line on the invoice.
entries.zh: 代理机构的预订费在发票上单独列示。

entries.en: Rooms cancelled within 24 hours will incur a one-night cancellation-fee.
entries.zh: 在24小时内取消的房间将收取一晚取消费。

entries.en: The bank charges a processing-fee for international transfers.
entries.zh: 银行对国际转账收取手续费。

entries.en: The registration-fee includes conference materials and two lunches.
entries.zh: 报名费包含会议资料和两顿午餐。

entries.en: The application-fee is refundable if the permit is denied.
entries.zh: 若许可被拒，申请费可退还。

entries.en: The annual membership-fee can be paid by credit card or bank transfer.
entries.zh: 年度会费可通过信用卡或银行转账支付。

entries.en: The keynote-speaker is the chief economist of a major bank.
entries.zh: 主题演讲人是一家大型银行的首席经济学家。

entries.en: All delegates are expected to attend the opening plenary.
entries.zh: 全体代表都应出席开幕全体会议。

entries.en: Please collect your name-tag at the registration desk.
entries.zh: 请在报到处领取姓名牌。

entries.en: Your badge and lanyard must be worn in all restricted areas.
entries.zh: 在所有限制区域都必须佩戴证件和挂绳。

entries.en: The microphone on the podium is already turned on.
entries.zh: 讲台上的麦克风已经打开。

entries.en: Speaker notes have been placed on the lectern.
entries.zh: 发言稿已放在讲桌上。

entries.en: The projector remote is in the drawer of the conference table.
entries.zh: 投影仪遥控器在会议桌抽屉里。

entries.en: Please leave the flipchart notes on the stand for the afternoon group.
entries.zh: 请把挂纸板上的记录留给下午的小组。

entries.en: The presenter asked for a laser-pointer and a spare set of batteries.
entries.zh: 演讲人要了一支激光笔和一组备用电池。

entries.en: Three members were absent from this morning's budget meeting.
entries.zh: 今天上午的预算会议有三名成员缺席。

entries.en: The laptop is sold with a carrying case and other accessories.
entries.zh: 这款笔记本电脑配有提包及其他配件。

entries.en: The administration has approved a new visitor registration procedure.
entries.zh: 行政部门已批准新的访客登记流程。

entries.en: The role includes light administrative work and calendar management.
entries.zh: 该职位包含少量行政工作和日程管理。

entries.en: Please contact the system administrator if you cannot log in.
entries.zh: 如果无法登录，请联系系统管理员。

entries.en: The security desk will admit visitors only with a confirmed appointment.
entries.zh: 保安台仅允许已确认预约的访客进入。

entries.en: The firm offers clear paths for career advancement.
entries.zh: 公司提供清晰的职业晋升路径。

entries.en: Both sides agreed to extend the contract by one year.
entries.zh: 双方同意将合同延长一年。

entries.en: The marketing allocation for the third quarter has been increased.
entries.zh: 第三季度的市场营销拨款已增加。

entries.en: The policy does not allow personal software on company laptops.
entries.zh: 该政策不允许在公司笔记本电脑上安装个人软件。

entries.en: Fire-safety training is conducted annually for all staff.
entries.zh: 所有员工每年都要参加消防安全培训。

entries.en: We apologize for the delay and have shipped a replacement today.
entries.zh: 我们对延误表示歉意，并已于今天寄出替换件。

entries.en: The showroom displays kitchen appliances for the hotel renovation.
entries.zh: 展厅陈列着酒店翻修用的厨房电器。

entries.en: Travel arrangements for the trade show have already been confirmed.
entries.zh: 展会的差旅安排已经确认。

entries.en: The final assembly of the machines takes place at the Shenzhen plant.
entries.zh: 机器的最终装配在深圳工厂完成。

entries.en: Please call the help desk if you need assistance with the new software.
entries.zh: 如果使用新软件需要帮助，请致电服务台。

entries.en: My assistant will send you the signed copies this afternoon.
entries.zh: 我的助理今天下午会把已签字的副本发给你。

entries.en: The forecast is based on the assumption that raw-material prices stay flat.
entries.zh: 该预测基于原材料价格保持平稳的假定。

entries.en: A flight attendant will collect landing cards before arrival.
entries.zh: 着陆前，乘务员将收回入境卡。

entries.meaning: 有吸引力的；有竞争力的
entries.en: The company offered an attractive relocation package.
entries.zh: 公司提供了很有吸引力的搬迁待遇。

entries.en: An automatic reminder is sent three days before the invoice is due.
entries.zh: 发票到期前三天会自动发出提醒。

entries.en: Approved expenses are automatically posted to the finance system.
entries.zh: 已批准的报销会自动记入财务系统。

entries.en: Please wear your badge at all times in the production area.
entries.zh: 在生产区请始终佩戴工牌。

entries.en: We barely met the delivery deadline after the storm delayed the trucks.
entries.zh: 暴风雨延误卡车后，我们勉强赶上交货期限。

entries.en: The printer will bind the annual report in hardcover.
entries.zh: 印刷厂将把年报装订成精装本。

entries.en: Boarding for the 4:40 flight will begin at gate 22.
entries.zh: 4:40航班将在22号登机口开始登机。

entries.en: A safety booklet is placed in every guest room.
entries.zh: 每间客房都放有一本安全小册子。

entries.en: The promotion is intended to boost weekend store traffic.
entries.zh: 此次促销旨在提升周末进店客流。

entries.en: The director will briefly outline the agenda before we begin.
entries.zh: 开始前，总监将简要说明议程。

entries.en: Please return the spare keys to the locked cabinet in the mail room.
entries.zh: 请把备用钥匙放回邮件室上锁的柜子里。

entries.en: Please confirm the cancellation in writing so we can release the room.
entries.zh: 请书面确认取消，以便我们释放房间。

entries.en: The new line has the capability to package 200 units per minute.
entries.zh: 新产线每分钟可包装200件。

entries.en: Please pay the invoice at the cashier on the ground floor.
entries.zh: 请到一楼出纳处支付发票。

entries.en: The board remains cautious about expanding into new markets this year.
entries.zh: 董事会对本年进入新市场仍持谨慎态度。

entries.en: The finance team is responsible for collection of overdue invoices.
entries.zh: 财务团队负责催收逾期发票。

entries.en: Please add your comments in the margin of the draft contract.
entries.zh: 请把意见写在合同草稿的空白处。

entries.en: We cannot take on another commitment until this project ships.
entries.zh: 在本项目发货前，我们不能再接下新的承诺。

entries.en: The safety committee meets on the first Monday of each month.
entries.zh: 安全委员会在每月第一个星期一开会。

entries.en: A shuttle for commuters leaves the station every 15 minutes.
entries.zh: 通勤班车每15分钟从车站发出一趟。

entries.en: The compact printer fits on a small hotel-office desk.
entries.zh: 这款紧凑型打印机放得下酒店办公室的小桌子。

entries.en: No comparable product is available at this price point.
entries.zh: 在这个价位上没有类似的产品。

entries.en: Please compare the three quotes before we award the contract.
entries.zh: 在授予合同前，请比较这三份报价。

entries.en: A price comparison is attached for the purchasing committee.
entries.zh: 价格对照表已附上，供采购委员会参考。

entries.en: Language competence is required for the overseas sales role.
entries.zh: 海外销售岗位要求具备语言能力。

entries.en: Several guests complained about the slow restaurant service.
entries.zh: 几位客人投诉餐厅服务太慢。

entries.en: Please complete the incident report before you leave today.
entries.zh: 请在今天离开前写完事故报告。

entries.en: Payment of the final invoice is due on completion of the work.
entries.zh: 尾款应在工程完成后支付。

entries.en: The system will compute the overtime automatically from the timesheets.
entries.zh: 系统将根据工时表自动计算加班。

entries.en: A replacement computer will be issued while yours is repaired.
entries.zh: 你的电脑送修期间，将发放一台替换电脑。

entries.en: In conclusion, we recommend delaying the launch by two weeks.
entries.zh: 总之，我们建议将发布推迟两周。

entries.en: I need to confer with legal before we accept those terms.
entries.zh: 在接受这些条款前，我需要与法务商议。

entries.en: You will receive a confirmation email once the booking is complete.
entries.zh: 预订完成后，你会收到一封确认邮件。

entries.en: We congratulate the design team on winning the industry award.
entries.zh: 我们祝贺设计团队获得该行业奖项。

entries.en: Congratulations on your promotion to regional manager.
entries.zh: 祝贺你晋升为区域经理。

entries.en: This train does not connect with the last bus to the factory.
entries.zh: 这班火车衔接不上前往工厂的末班巴士。

entries.en: A short delay in Chicago caused us to miss our connection to Boston.
entries.zh: 芝加哥的短暂延误使我们错过了前往波士顿的转乘航班。

entries.en: The board will consider the expansion proposal at its next meeting.
entries.zh: 董事会将在下次会议上考虑这项扩张提案。

entries.en: Thank you for your consideration of our bid.
entries.zh: 感谢贵方考虑我们的投标。

entries.en: The kit consists of a charger, a cable, and a user guide.
entries.zh: 套装包括充电器、线和一本使用指南。

entries.en: Construction of the parking deck will begin after the holiday weekend.
entries.zh: 停车楼的施工将在节日周末后开始。

entries.en: A public consultation will be held before the route change is approved.
entries.zh: 在批准线路变更前将举行公众咨询。

entries.en: Consumer demand for smaller packages has increased this year.
entries.zh: 今年消费者对小包装的需求有所增加。

entries.en: The crate contains twelve units and a spare-parts kit.
entries.zh: 这个板条箱里有十二台设备和一套备件。

entries.en: The container will leave the port on Thursday evening.
entries.zh: 该集装箱将于周四晚上离港。

entries.en: Your contribution to the pension plan is deducted from each paycheck.
entries.zh: 你的养老金缴款将从每期工资中扣除。

entries.en: Conventional mail is still used for contracts that require original signatures.
entries.zh: 仍需原件签字的合同还是会用传统邮寄。

entries.en: A cooperative effort between sales and logistics shortened delivery times.
entries.zh: 销售与物流的合作缩短了交货时间。

entries.en: Better coordination with the airline reduced missed connections.
entries.zh: 与航空公司更好的协调减少了误机。

entries.en: The event coordinator will confirm the seating plan tomorrow.
entries.zh: 活动协调员明天将确认座位安排。

entries.en: Please make a copy of the signed form for your records.
entries.zh: 请把已签字的表格复印一份留存。

entries.en: Please correct the shipping address before the labels are printed.
entries.zh: 在打印标签前，请更正收货地址。

entries.en: A last-minute venue change would be costly and disruptive.
entries.zh: 临时更换场地既昂贵又会造成混乱。

entries.en: The city council approved the permit for the new warehouse.
entries.zh: 市议会批准了新仓库的许可。

entries.en: Please pick up your badges at the registration counter.
entries.zh: 请到登记柜台领取胸牌。

entries.en: Please create a shared folder for the bid documents.
entries.zh: 请为投标文件创建一个共享文件夹。

entries.en: The creative team will present three campaign concepts on Monday.
entries.zh: 创意团队周一将展示三个活动方案。

entries.en: The position is currently filled on a temporary basis.
entries.zh: 该职位目前由临时人员担任。

entries.en: The sales team closed a three-year deal with a major retailer.
entries.zh: 销售团队与一家大型零售商敲定了一份三年期交易。

entries.en: Authorized dealers will handle all warranty repairs.
entries.zh: 授权经销商将负责所有保修维修。

entries.en: The committee debated whether to extend store hours on weeknights.
entries.zh: 委员会讨论了是否延长工作日晚间营业时间。

entries.en: We will decide on the venue after we compare the three quotes.
entries.zh: 比较三份报价后，我们将决定场地。

entries.en: A final decision on the relocation will be announced on Friday.
entries.zh: 关于搬迁的最终决定将于周五公布。

entries.en: One conference room will be dedicated to client presentations.
entries.zh: 一间会议室将专门用于客户演示。

entries.en: The tax deduction for home-office expenses has changed this year.
entries.zh: 今年家庭办公费用的税前扣除规定有所变化。

entries.en: The contract should clearly define the acceptance criteria.
entries.zh: 合同应明确规定验收标准。

entries.en: We can definitely deliver the first batch by the twelfth.
entries.zh: 我们肯定能在12日前交付第一批。

entries.en: A written definition of 'urgent request' will be added to the handbook.
entries.zh: 手册中将增加对“紧急请求”的书面定义。

entries.en: Please delete the draft file after the final version is issued.
entries.zh: 最终版发布后，请删除草稿文件。

entries.en: The committee will deliberate on the bids overnight.
entries.zh: 委员会将连夜仔细审议这些投标。

entries.en: Same-day delivery is available within the city limits.
entries.zh: 市区范围内可提供当日送达。

entries.en: A product demonstration is scheduled for 2 p.m. in Hall B.
entries.zh: 产品演示定于下午2点在B厅举行。

entries.en: The insurer denied the claim because the report was filed too late.
entries.zh: 保险公司拒绝了索赔，因为报告提交太晚。

entries.en: The shuttle will depart from the main entrance at 6:45 a.m.
entries.zh: 班车将于早上6:45从正门出发。

entries.en: Please send the request to the legal department for review.
entries.zh: 请把该申请送交法务部门审核。

entries.en: The shipping date will depend on when the parts arrive.
entries.zh: 发货日期取决于零件何时到达。

entries.en: Health coverage can be extended to eligible dependents.
entries.zh: 医疗保险可扩大到符合条件的家属。

entries.en: Please describe the fault in as much detail as possible.
entries.zh: 请尽可能详细地描述故障情况。

entries.en: The warehouse team deserves recognition for meeting the holiday rush.
entries.zh: 仓库团队成功应对假日高峰，值得表彰。

entries.en: The design of the new packaging reduces shipping damage.
entries.zh: 新包装的设计减少了运输损坏。

entries.en: The graphic designer will revise the cover by Thursday.
entries.zh: 平面设计师将在周四前修改封面。

entries.en: The lab will develop a lighter casing for the next model.
entries.zh: 实验室将为下一型号开发更轻的外壳。

entries.en: Product development is expected to take nine months.
entries.zh: 产品开发预计需要九个月。

entries.en: Please return the loaner device when your laptop is repaired.
entries.zh: 笔记本电脑修好后，请归还借用设备。

entries.en: The lab received a brand-new spectrometer this morning.
entries.zh: 实验室今天上午收到一台全新的光谱仪。

entries.en: She has been granted three months of study-leave to complete the certification.
entries.zh: 她获准休三个月进修假以完成认证。

entries.en: Please submit a doctor's note if medical-leave lasts more than two days.
entries.zh: 医疗假超过两天请提交医生证明。

entries.en: Personal-leave must be requested at least three days in advance, except in emergencies.
entries.zh: 除紧急情况外，事假须至少提前三天申请。

entries.en: Employees called for jury-duty should notify their supervisor as soon as possible.
entries.zh: 被召担任陪审员的员工应尽快通知主管。

entries.en: Under compressed-hours, staff work longer days in exchange for a weekday off.
entries.zh: 在压缩工时制度下，员工延长每日工时以换取一个工作日休息。

entries.en: Shift-work premiums are listed in the plant's labor agreement.
entries.zh: 轮班津贴列在工厂的劳工协议中。

entries.en: Drivers on a split-shift have an unpaid break in the middle of the day.
entries.zh: 上分段班的司机在中午有一段无薪休息时间。

entries.en: The rotating-shift schedule changes every two weeks.
entries.zh: 轮换班次每两周调整一次。

entries.en: The swing-shift begins at 4 p.m. and ends at midnight.
entries.zh: 中班从下午4点到午夜。

entries.en: Two supervisors are assigned to the graveyard-shift in the packing hall.
entries.zh: 包装车间的大夜班安排了两名主管。

entries.en: Holiday-pay applies to staff who work on official public holidays.
entries.zh: 在法定假日工作的员工可领取假日工资。

entries.en: If we end the contract early, notice-pay will be included in the final settlement.
entries.zh: 若我们提前终止合同，最后结算将包含代通知金。

entries.en: Sick-pay begins on the second consecutive day of absence.
entries.zh: 病假工资从连续缺勤的第二天起计算。

entries.en: Maternity-pay is calculated from the employee's average earnings.
entries.zh: 产假工资按员工平均收入计算。

entries.en: Vision-insurance covers one eye exam and a pair of glasses each year.
entries.zh: 视力保险每年报销一次眼科检查和一副眼镜。

entries.en: Contributions to unemployment-insurance are shown on your payslip.
entries.zh: 失业保险缴款列在你的工资单上。

entries.en: Property-insurance for the warehouse was renewed last month.
entries.zh: 仓库的财产保险已于上个月续保。

entries.meaning: 职业责任保险；专业赔偿保险
entries.en: Consultants must carry professional-indemnity cover before starting work.
entries.zh: 咨询顾问在开工前必须投保职业责任保险。

entries.en: The board approved key-person-insurance for the chief engineer.
entries.zh: 董事会批准为总工程师购买关键人物保险。

entries.meaning: 成本加成的；成本加成合同
entries.en: The renovation will be billed on a cost-plus basis.
entries.zh: 此次装修将按成本加成方式计费。

entries.meaning: 固定价格的；一口价合同
entries.en: We prefer a fixed-price contract to avoid unexpected overruns.
entries.zh: 我们更倾向固定价格合同，以避免意外超支。

entries.en: A monthly retainer-fee covers up to ten hours of legal advice.
entries.zh: 每月顾问聘金包含最多十小时的法律咨询。

entries.en: The recruiter's success-fee is payable when the candidate starts work.
entries.zh: 候选人到岗后，须支付招聘顾问的成功酬金。

entries.en: A finders-fee will be paid if this introduction leads to a signed lease.
entries.zh: 如果这次介绍促成已签署的租约，将支付介绍费。

entries.en: A service-fee of 10 percent is added to all banquet invoices.
entries.zh: 所有宴会发票另加10%服务费。

entries.en: Paying by credit card online incurs a small convenience-fee.
entries.zh: 在线用信用卡付款会收取少量便利手续费。

entries.en: Each new hire receives a welcome-pack on the first morning.
entries.zh: 每位新员工第一天上午都会收到一份迎新资料包。

entries.en: Please reserve an aisle-seat so I can leave the row during the flight.
entries.zh: 请帮我预订靠过道座位，以便飞行途中进出。

entries.en: The client requested a window-seat on the morning flight to Chicago.
entries.zh: 客户要求预订早上飞往芝加哥航班的靠窗座位。

entries.en: Passengers in the exit-row must be able to assist in an evacuation.
entries.zh: 坐在紧急出口排的乘客必须能够协助疏散。

entries.en: You have been placed on the wait-list for Saturday's workshop.
entries.zh: 你已进入周六研讨班的候补名单。

entries.en: A standby-ticket may get you on an earlier flight if seats open up.
entries.zh: 如果出现空位，候补机票可能让你搭上更早的航班。

entries.en: The company booked a charter-flight for the inspection team.
entries.zh: 公司为考察团预订了包机。

entries.meaning: 班次频繁的短途航班；摆渡航班
entries.en: A shuttle-flight runs hourly between the two city airports.
entries.zh: 两个市区机场之间每小时有一班摆渡航班。

entries.en: The commuter-flight from the regional airport takes only 40 minutes.
entries.zh: 从支线机场出发的通勤航班只需40分钟。

entries.en: The airline rebooked us after the cancelled-flight was announced.
entries.zh: 航班取消公布后，航空公司为我们重新订位。

entries.en: Compensation for denied-boarding is explained at the ticket counter.
entries.zh: 关于拒绝登机的赔偿说明可在售票柜台查询。

entries.en: You may gate-check the stroller just before you board.
entries.zh: 你可以在登机前在登机口托运婴儿车。

entries.en: Excess-baggage fees can be paid at the oversize counter.
entries.zh: 超重行李费可在超大行李柜台支付。

entries.en: Please complete a lost-luggage form before leaving the baggage hall.
entries.zh: 离开行李大厅前请填写行李丢失登记表。

entries.en: Toiletry kits are available if your delayed-luggage has not arrived.
entries.zh: 如果延误的行李尚未到达，可领取洗漱包。

entries.en: Keep the baggage-tag until you collect your suitcase.
entries.zh: 领取行李箱之前请保管好行李牌。

entries.en: Present your claim-check at the counter to collect the repaired laptop.
entries.zh: 请在柜台出示取物凭证以领取修好的笔记本电脑。

entries.en: A travel-adapter is provided in each executive room.
entries.zh: 每间行政客房都提供旅行转换插头。

entries.en: Do not use a hair dryer abroad without a voltage-converter.
entries.zh: 在国外使用吹风机时请配电压转换器。

entries.en: Duty-free allowances are posted near the customs channel.
entries.zh: 免税额度公示在海关通道附近。

entries.en: Please have your passport ready at the immigration-counter.
entries.zh: 到达入境检查台时请准备好护照。

entries.en: A customs-declaration must be completed for commercial samples.
entries.zh: 携带商业样品必须填写海关申报单。

entries.en: Cabin crew will collect the landing-card before we land.
entries.zh: 着陆前乘务组将收回入境卡。

entries.en: Remember to keep the departure-card until you pass immigration.
entries.zh: 在通过出入境检查前请保留出境卡。

entries.en: An arrival-card will be distributed during the flight.
entries.zh: 飞行途中将分发入境登记卡。

entries.en: Visa-on-arrival is available only to travelers with a confirmed hotel booking.
entries.zh: 只有已确认酒店预订的旅客才能办理落地签证。

entries.en: A transit-visa is required if you leave the airport during the layover.
entries.zh: 若在中转期间离开机场，需要过境签证。

entries.en: The tourist-visa does not permit paid work during the stay.
entries.zh: 旅游签证不允许在停留期间从事有偿工作。

entries.en: The new engineer cannot start until the work-permit is issued.
entries.zh: 在工作许可签发前，新工程师不能上岗。

entries.en: A residence-permit is required for assignments longer than 90 days.
entries.zh: 超过90天的派驻需要居留许可。

entries.en: Some assignments require an exit-permit before staff can leave the country.
entries.zh: 部分派驻在员工离境前需要出境许可。

entries.en: Apply for a reentry-permit if you will travel home during the posting.
entries.zh: 若在派驻期间回国，请申请再入境许可。

entries.en: Room-service is available until midnight on weekdays.
entries.zh: 工作日的客房服务营业至午夜。

entries.en: Please arrange a wake-up-call for 5:30 a.m.
entries.zh: 请安排早上5:30的叫早服务。

entries.en: Early-check-in depends on whether the room is ready.
entries.zh: 能否提前入住取决于房间是否已打扫好。

entries.meaning: 未经预约的访客；上门客
entries.en: The clinic accepts walk-in patients after 3 p.m.
entries.zh: 该诊所下午3点后接受未经预约的患者。

entries.en: Please reserve an adjoining-room for the visiting auditor.
entries.zh: 请为来访的审计人员预订一间相邻客房。

entries.en: A connecting-room is needed so the team can work in the sitting area.
entries.zh: 需要一间连通房，方便团队在起居区工作。

entries.en: Please place the contract originals in the safe-deposit at the front desk.
entries.zh: 请把合同原件放入前台的保险箱。

entries.en: The breakfast-buffet opens at 6:30 for early departures.
entries.zh: 为方便早出发的客人，自助早餐6:30开始。

entries.en: The conference package is offered on a half-board basis.
entries.zh: 会议套餐按半膳宿（含早晚餐）提供。

entries.en: Full-board is recommended because the training site is far from restaurants.
entries.zh: 培训地点远离餐厅，建议选择全膳宿。

entries.en: The all-inclusive rate covers meals, meeting rooms, and local transport.
entries.zh: 一价全包费率包含餐食、会议室和当地交通。

entries.en: A bed-and-breakfast near the station is cheaper than the downtown hotels.
entries.zh: 车站附近的早餐民宿比市区酒店更便宜。

entries.en: Laundry-service collected before 9 a.m. will be returned the same day.
entries.zh: 上午9点前送洗的衣物可当天送回。

entries.en: Please send the uniforms out for dry-cleaning before the ceremony.
entries.zh: 请在典礼前把制服送去干洗。

entries.en: Please replace any missing price-tag before the store opens.
entries.zh: 开店前请补上缺失的价格标签。

entries.en: The cash-register was offline for twenty minutes during the update.
entries.zh: 系统更新期间，收银机离线了二十分钟。

entries.en: The receipt-printer needs a new paper roll.
entries.zh: 收据打印机需要更换纸卷。

entries.en: A handheld barcode-scanner is used for the stock count.
entries.zh: 盘点时使用手持条码扫描器。

entries.en: When stock falls to the reorder-point, the system places an automatic order.
entries.zh: 库存降到再订货点时，系统会自动下单。

entries.en: A weekly cycle-count is performed on high-value items.
entries.zh: 高价值商品每周进行循环盘点。

entries.en: A stock-out of printer toner delayed the mailing by a day.
entries.zh: 打印机碳粉缺货使邮寄延误了一天。

entries.en: We use drop-shipping for oversized furniture that will not fit in our warehouse.
entries.zh: 超大家具仓库放不下，我们采用代发货。

entries.en: Cross-docking allows inbound goods to leave the same day without storage.
entries.zh: 越库配送使到货可以当天发出，无需入库储存。

entries.en: The pick-and-pack team works until 9 p.m. during the sale.
entries.zh: 促销期间，拣货包装组营业至晚上9点。

entries.en: Please record the lot-number on every quality report.
entries.zh: 请在每份质量报告上记录批号。

entries.en: The recall applies only to products with this batch-number.
entries.zh: 此次召回仅适用于该批次号的产品。

entries.en: Warranty service requires the serial-number on the nameplate.
entries.zh: 保修服务需要铭牌上的序列号。

entries.en: Do not ship any items past their expiration-date.
entries.zh: 请勿发运已过到期日的商品。

entries.meaning: 保质期；最佳食用日期前
entries.en: Items approaching their best-before date should be moved to the discount shelf.
entries.zh: 临近保质期的商品应移到折扣货架。

entries.en: The store cannot display food after its sell-by date.
entries.zh: 过了最迟销售日期的食品不得继续陈列。

entries.en: A cooler storage area extends the shelf-life of the samples.
entries.zh: 低温储存可延长样品的保质期。

entries.en: Temperature-control records must accompany every cold-chain shipment.
entries.zh: 每批冷链货物都必须附有温控记录。

entries.en: A shortage of raw-material has slowed the morning shift.
entries.zh: 原材料短缺拖慢了早班进度。

entries.en: Work-in-progress should not be counted as finished inventory.
entries.zh: 在制品不应计入成品库存。

entries.en: Finished-goods are stored in the west warehouse until dispatch.
entries.zh: 成品在发货前存放在西侧仓库。

entries.en: Please update the bill-of-materials after the design change.
entries.zh: 设计变更后请更新物料清单。

entries.en: Shorter setup-time will let us run smaller batches profitably.
entries.zh: 缩短换线时间后，小批量生产也能盈利。

entries.en: The defect-rate fell after the new inspection step was added.
entries.zh: 增加新的检验步骤后，不良率下降了。

entries.en: The plant adopted lean-manufacturing to reduce wasted motion.
entries.zh: 工厂采用精益生产以减少无效动作。

entries.en: Preventive-maintenance is scheduled for the first Sunday of each month.
entries.zh: 预防性维护安排在每月第一个星期日。

entries.en: Sensors support predictive-maintenance before a motor fails.
entries.zh: 传感器可在电机故障前支持预测性维护。

entries.en: Corrective-maintenance on the conveyor will take most of the night shift.
entries.zh: 输送带的纠正性维修将占用大部分夜班时间。

entries.en: Please attach the cash-flow-statement to the loan application.
entries.zh: 请把现金流量表附在贷款申请中。

entries.en: The aged-receivables report highlights accounts more than 60 days overdue.
entries.zh: 应收账款账龄报告标出了逾期60天以上的账户。

entries.en: We will clear the oldest items on the aged-payables list this week.
entries.zh: 本周将清掉应付账款账龄表上最旧的项目。

entries.en: Annual subscriptions are recorded first as unearned-revenue.
entries.zh: 年度订阅费先记为预收账款。

entries.en: The insurance premium is treated as a prepaid-expense and released monthly.
entries.zh: 保险费作为预付费用入账，并按月摊销。

entries.en: Deferred-tax items are explained in note 14 of the annual report.
entries.zh: 递延税款项目在年报附注14中说明。

entries.en: The acquired brand name is recognized as an intangible-asset.
entries.zh: 收购的品牌被确认为无形资产。

entries.en: Vehicles and machinery are the company's main tangible-assets.
entries.zh: 车辆和机器是公司的主要有形资产。

entries.en: Please register the new printer as a fixed-asset, not as a consumable.
entries.zh: 请把新打印机登记为固定资产，而不是耗材。

entries.en: Cash and receivables are reported under current-assets.
entries.zh: 现金和应收账款列在流动资产项下。

entries.en: The bank loan due in six months is a current-liability.
entries.zh: 六个月内到期的银行贷款属于流动负债。

entries.en: The mortgage is classified as a long-term-liability.
entries.zh: 该抵押贷款被归类为长期负债。

entries.en: The dividend will be paid from retained-earnings.
entries.zh: 股息将从留存收益中支付。

entries.en: The share issue increased paid-in-capital by two million dollars.
entries.zh: 此次发行股票使实收资本增加了两百万美元。

entries.en: The company bought back shares and holds them as treasury-stock.
entries.zh: 公司回购股票并作为库存股持有。

entries.en: A two-for-one stock-split will take effect on June 1.
entries.zh: 一拆二的股票分割将于6月1日生效。

entries.en: Eligible managers may receive a stock-option grant each spring.
entries.zh: 符合条件的经理每年春季可获得股票期权。

entries.en: Payroll-tax withholdings are itemized on the monthly payslip.
entries.zh: 工资税扣缴明细列在每月工资单上。

entries.en: The invoice must show the value-added-tax separately.
entries.zh: 发票必须单独列示增值税。

entries.en: Prices on the menu include goods-and-services-tax.
entries.zh: 菜单价格已含商品及服务税。

entries.en: An excise-tax applies to certain imported fuels.
entries.zh: 某些进口燃料需缴纳消费税。

entries.en: Stamp-duty is payable on the property transfer documents.
entries.zh: 财产转让文件须缴纳印花税。

entries.en: Capital-gains-tax may apply when the subsidiary is sold.
entries.zh: 出售子公司时可能需要缴纳资本利得税。

entries.en: The corporate-tax return is due at the end of the third month.
entries.zh: 企业所得税申报于第三个月末到期。

entries.en: Income-tax is withheld from each paycheck according to your tax code.
entries.zh: 所得税按你的税务编码从每期工资中扣除。

entries.en: Property-tax on the factory is paid in two installments.
entries.zh: 工厂的财产税分两期缴纳。

entries.en: Please ask legal whether estate-tax affects the share transfer.
entries.zh: 请向法务咨询遗产税是否影响此次股权转让。

entries.en: Inheritance-tax rules differ depending on the country of residence.
entries.zh: 继承税规则因居住国而异。

entries.en: Withholding-tax will be deducted from the overseas royalty payment.
entries.zh: 海外特许权使用费将扣除预扣税。

entries.en: Please file the tax-return before the April deadline.
entries.zh: 请在四月截止日期前递交纳税申报表。

entries.en: A research tax-credit may reduce the amount payable this year.
entries.zh: 研发税收抵免可能减少今年的应纳税额。

entries.en: Charitable donations may qualify for a tax-deduction.
entries.zh: 慈善捐赠可能符合税前扣除条件。

entries.en: The foundation has been granted a tax-exemption on donation income.
entries.zh: 该基金会对捐赠收入获得了免税。

entries.en: Please keep the receipts in case of a tax-audit.
entries.zh: 请保留收据，以备税务稽查。

entries.en: A tax-clearance certificate is required before the license can be renewed.
entries.zh: 在续期许可证前需要完税证明。

entries.en: The role is advertised in salary-band 4 of the current scale.
entries.zh: 该职位按现行薪级第4薪资带宽招聘。

entries.en: A promotion to the next pay-grade takes effect in the following month.
entries.zh: 晋升到下一工资等级将于次月生效。

entries.en: The updated pay-scale will be posted on the intranet.
entries.zh: 更新后的薪级表将发布在内网上。

entries.en: Commission is paid in addition to the base-salary.
entries.zh: 提成在基本工资之外另行支付。

entries.en: Overtime is calculated on the basic-salary, not on bonuses.
entries.zh: 加班费按基本工资计算，不含奖金。

entries.en: Your gross-salary includes the housing allowance.
entries.zh: 你的税前工资包含住房津贴。

entries.en: The transfer on the 25th is your net-salary after deductions.
entries.zh: 25日到账的是扣款后的实发工资。

entries.en: A change in tax code will affect your take-home-pay from May.
entries.zh: 税务编码变更将从五月起影响你的实得工资。

entries.en: The bonus-scheme is based on both team and individual targets.
entries.zh: 该奖金方案同时依据团队和个人目标。

entries.en: The new commission-structure rewards repeat business.
entries.zh: 新的提成结构奖励回头客业务。

entries.en: Eligible staff join the profit-sharing plan after one year of service.
entries.zh: 符合条件的员工在任职满一年后加入利润分享计划。

entries.en: Please complete your self-evaluation before the mid-year-review.
entries.zh: 请在年中评估前完成自我评价。

entries.en: Salary adjustments are discussed during the annual-review.
entries.zh: 薪资调整在年度评估时讨论。

entries.en: A short self-assessment should be submitted a week before the meeting.
entries.zh: 请在会议前一周提交简短的自我评估。

entries.en: Peer-review comments are used only for development, not for discipline.
entries.zh: 同事互评意见仅用于发展，不用于处分。

entries.en: The handbook describes a career-path from analyst to manager.
entries.zh: 手册说明了从分析师到经理的职业发展路径。

entries.en: A verbal-warning was issued after the first safety violation.
entries.zh: 第一次违反安全规定后给予了口头警告。

entries.en: A final-warning is placed on file for twelve months.
entries.zh: 最后警告将在档案中保留十二个月。

entries.en: Repeated lateness may result in disciplinary-action.
entries.zh: 屡次迟到可能导致纪律处分。

entries.en: The termination-letter will be delivered by courier tomorrow.
entries.zh: 解聘通知书将于明天由快递送达。

entries.en: You may request a reference-letter from your previous supervisor.
entries.zh: 你可向前任主管索取推荐信。

entries.en: Please attach a recommendation-letter to the scholarship application.
entries.zh: 请在奖学金申请中附上推荐信。

entries.en: Your start date is confirmed in the appointment-letter.
entries.zh: 聘任书中确认了你的到岗日期。

entries.en: Please submit a resignation-letter to human resources and your manager.
entries.zh: 请向人力资源部和经理提交辞职信。

entries.en: An acceptance-letter should be returned within five business days.
entries.zh: 接受函应在五个工作日内退回。

entries.en: A rejection-letter will be sent to candidates who are not shortlisted.
entries.zh: 未进入短名单的候选人将收到不录用通知。

entries.en: A handling-charge applies to orders below the minimum quantity.
entries.zh: 低于最低起订量的订单需收取手续费。

entries.en: A daily storage-charge begins after five free days at the terminal.
entries.zh: 码头五天免费期过后将开始按日收取仓储费。

entries.en: The packing-charge is waived for orders over 500 units.
entries.zh: 超过500件的订单免收包装费。

entries.en: Please issue a tax-invoice so we can claim the input credit.
entries.zh: 请开具税务发票，以便我们申请进项抵扣。

entries.en: No payment will be released without a goods-received record.
entries.zh: 没有收货记录不得放款。

entries.en: Please approve the contractor's time-sheet by Friday noon.
entries.zh: 请在周五中午前批准承包人员的工时表。

entries.en: Customs has asked for a copy of the airway-bill.
entries.zh: 海关要求提供航空运单副本。

entries.en: Facilities bought replacement locks at the hardware-store downtown.
entries.zh: 总务部门在市区五金店购买了替换锁具。

entries.en: The supplier filed for bankruptcy, so we are seeking a second source.
entries.zh: 该供应商已申请破产，所以我们正在寻找第二供货来源。

entries.en: Compensation for the cancelled workshop will be issued as a credit.
entries.zh: 已取消研讨班的费用将以贷记方式补偿。

entries.en: Competition in the mid-range segment has intensified this year.
entries.zh: 中端市场竞争今年明显加剧。

entries.en: We need a more competitive delivery time to win the bid.
entries.zh: 要赢得投标，我们需要更有竞争力的交货期。

entries.en: Please confirm the meeting time with the client's assistant.
entries.zh: 请与客户助理确认会议时间。

entries.en: An external consultant will review the payroll process.
entries.zh: 外部顾问将审查工资流程。

entries.en: Customs will not release the goods without complete documentation.
entries.zh: 没有完整文件，海关不会放行货物。

entries.en: A weaker economy has reduced demand for luxury travel packages.
entries.zh: 经济走弱降低了奢华旅行套餐的需求。

entries.en: The chief economist will brief the board on interest-rate risks.
entries.zh: 首席经济学家将向董事会介绍利率风险。

entries.en: The new layout improved efficiency in the packing area.
entries.zh: 新的布局提高了包装区的效率。

entries.en: An electrician will replace the faulty wiring tonight.
entries.zh: 电工今晚将更换故障线路。

entries.en: Please submit an electronic copy as well as the signed original.
entries.zh: 请同时提交电子副本和已签字的原件。

entries.en: In an emergency, use the stairs, not the elevators.
entries.zh: 遇到紧急情况请走楼梯，不要乘电梯。

entries.en: Your employer will provide a letter confirming your job title and salary.
entries.zh: 雇主将出具一封确认职位和薪资的信函。

entries.en: Previous employment should be listed in reverse chronological order.
entries.zh: 以往的工作经历应按时间倒序列出。

entries.en: A service engineer will be on site at 9 a.m.
entries.zh: 维修工程师将于上午9点到现场。

entries.en: The engineering team has signed off on the design change.
entries.zh: 工程团队已签字批准这项设计变更。

entries.en: Enrollment in the evening language course closes on Friday.
entries.zh: 晚间语言课程的报名于周五截止。

entries.en: The incubator supports entrepreneurs who are launching export businesses.
entries.zh: 该孵化器支持正在开展出口业务的创业者。

entries.en: The new plant was designed to reduce its impact on the environment.
entries.zh: 新工厂的设计旨在减少对环境的影响。

entries.en: An environmental permit is required before construction can start.
entries.zh: 施工开始前必须获得环境许可。

entries.en: The establishment of a local office will help us serve regional clients.
entries.zh: 设立当地办事处将有助于服务区域客户。

entries.en: The industrial estate has two remaining lots for sale.
entries.zh: 该工业园区还剩两块地出售。

entries.en: Exceptional performance this quarter will be recognized at the all-hands.
entries.zh: 本季度的杰出表现将在全员大会上表彰。

entries.en: You may exchange unsold merchandise within 14 days with a receipt.
entries.zh: 未售出的商品可在14天内凭收据兑换。

entries.en: Please keep the emergency exit clear of boxes.
entries.zh: 请勿在紧急出口堆放纸箱。

entries.en: An expert in food safety will inspect the kitchen tomorrow.
entries.zh: 食品安全专家明天将来检查厨房。

entries.en: Export licenses are required for some of the testing equipment.
entries.zh: 部分测试设备需要出口许可证。

entries.en: A tour of the factory is included in the customer visit.
entries.zh: 客户来访行程包含参观工厂。

entries.en: A farewell lunch will be held for colleagues who are transferring.
entries.zh: 将为调职的同事举行送别午餐。

entries.en: We received a favorable inspection report from the buyer.
entries.zh: 我们收到了买方出具的有利检验报告。

entries.en: The samples will go by ferry if the afternoon flight is full.
entries.zh: 如果下午的航班已满，样品将改搭渡轮。

entries.en: A financial summary is included on the last page of the proposal.
entries.zh: 提案最后一页附有财务摘要。

entries.en: Please reconfirm your flight 24 hours before departure.
entries.zh: 请在出发前24小时重新确认航班。

entries.en: Currency fluctuation has affected our import costs.
entries.zh: 汇率波动影响了我们的进口成本。

entries.en: The founder will open the new branch on Monday.
entries.zh: 创始人将于周一为新分店开业。

entries.en: The new ethics framework will apply to all suppliers.
entries.zh: 新的道德准则将适用于所有供应商。

entries.en: Any suspected fraud should be reported to the compliance office.
entries.zh: 任何可疑欺诈行为都应向合规部门报告。

entries.en: Bus frequency to the airport increases during the morning peak.
entries.zh: 早高峰前往机场的巴士班次会增加。

entries.en: Visitor parking is in the garage behind the lobby.
entries.zh: 访客停车位在大厅后方的车库。

entries.en: The next generation of the device will be lighter and quieter.
entries.zh: 下一代产品将更轻、更安静。

entries.en: The consultant's terms-of-reference are attached to the engagement letter.
entries.zh: 顾问的职责范围已附在聘用函中。

entries.en: Please issue a stop-order on further shipments until the quality issue is fixed.
entries.zh: 在质量问题解决前，请下达停止继续发货的指令。

entries.meaning: 定期付款指令；长期订单
entries.en: A standing-order pays the office rent on the first of each month.
entries.zh: 定期付款指令会在每月1日支付办公室租金。

entries.en: The refund will be sent as a money-order if you do not have a bank account.
entries.zh: 若你没有银行账户，退款将以汇票形式寄出。

entries.en: A consular-invoice is required for this destination and must be stamped at the embassy.
entries.zh: 该目的地需要领事发票，并须在使馆盖章。

entries.en: The new bunker-adjustment will appear on ocean-freight invoices from July.
entries.zh: 新的燃油附加费调整将从七月起体现在海运发票上。

entries.en: A currency-adjustment was added after the dollar weakened.
entries.zh: 美元走弱后加收了货币调整附加费。

entries.en: I have added your name to the upgrade-list for the evening flight.
entries.zh: 我已把你的名字加入晚班航班的升舱候补名单。

entries.en: A red-eye-flight would get the team to the site before the morning inspection.
entries.zh: 乘坐红眼航班可以让团队在上午检查前到达现场。

entries.en: Packing-cubes are useful when several colleagues share one sample case.
entries.zh: 几位同事共用一个样品箱时，收纳袋很有用。

entries.en: The delay was caused by congestion reported by the control-tower.
entries.zh: 延误是由于塔台报告的拥堵造成的。

entries.en: Please confirm that the suite has a king-bed, not two twins.
entries.zh: 请确认套房是特大号床，而不是两张单人床。

entries.en: The training rooms should be set up with twin-bed arrangements for the inspectors.
entries.zh: 培训客房应为检查人员安排两张单人床。

entries.en: An ironing-board and an iron are in the closet of each guest room.
entries.zh: 每间客房的壁柜里都有熨衣板和熨斗。

entries.en: Please do not remove the hair-dryer from the bathroom wall bracket.
entries.zh: 请不要把吹风机从卫生间壁架上取走带走。

entries.en: Shoe-shine is available at the lobby from 7 a.m.
entries.zh: 大厅从早上7点起提供擦鞋服务。

entries.en: Scan the QR-code on your badge to record attendance.
entries.zh: 扫描胸牌上的二维码即可记录出勤。

entries.en: Each color and size has a separate stock-keeping-unit.
entries.zh: 每种颜色和尺码都有单独的库存量单位。

entries.en: Please put a shelf-talker next to the new product display.
entries.zh: 请在新产品陈列处放置货架插卡。

entries.en: Investors asked for the statement-of-cash-flows for the past three years.
entries.zh: 投资者要求提供过去三年的现金流量表。

entries.en: Restricted-stock vests over three years if performance targets are met.
entries.zh: 若达到业绩目标，限制性股票将在三年内归属。

entries.en: Social-security contributions are shared by the employee and the employer.
entries.zh: 社会保障缴款由员工和雇主共同承担。

entries.en: Unemployment-tax is calculated on a portion of each employee's wages.
entries.zh: 失业税按每位员工部分工资计算。

entries.en: The policy forbids routing payments through a tax-haven without legal review.
entries.zh: 未经法务审查，政策禁止经避税地安排付款。

entries.en: A stock-grant will be awarded after the probation period.
entries.zh: 试用期结束后将授予股票。

entries.en: The option-grant expires if it is not exercised within seven years.
entries.zh: 期权若在七年内未行权即告失效。

entries.en: Please draft an individual-development-plan before the mid-year review.
entries.zh: 请在年中评估前起草个人发展计划。

entries.en: The product launch will be held in the main auditorium.
entries.zh: 产品发布会将在主礼堂举行。

entries.en: Please double-check the overtime calculation before payroll is run.
entries.zh: 在发放工资前，请再核对一遍加班计算。

entries.en: The autumn catalogue will be sent to retailers next week.
entries.zh: 秋季目录将于下周寄给零售商。

entries.en: The hotel chef will design a menu for the awards dinner.
entries.zh: 酒店主厨将为颁奖晚宴设计菜单。

entries.en: Please use the current price list, not last year's version.
entries.zh: 请使用当前价目表，不要用去年的版本。

entries.en: Dental coverage begins after 90 days of employment.
entries.zh: 牙科保障在入职90天后生效。

entries.en: A wiring diagram is included in the installation guide.
entries.zh: 安装指南中附有接线图。

entries.en: A digital copy of the manual is available on the support site.
entries.zh: 支持网站上提供手册的电子版。

entries.en: Please confirm the crate dimensions before we book the truck.
entries.zh: 在预订卡车前，请确认板条箱尺寸。

entries.en: Clear directions to the loading dock are posted at the gate.
entries.zh: 大门处张贴了前往装卸台的清晰指示。

entries.en: The finance director will sign off on invoices over 10,000 dollars.
entries.zh: 超过一万美元的发票须由财务总监签字。

entries.en: Please disable temporary visitor badges at the end of each day.
entries.zh: 请在每天结束时停用临时访客证。

entries.en: The older warehouse has the disadvantage of limited dock space.
entries.zh: 旧仓库的缺点是装卸位有限。

entries.en: We discourage personal calls on the shop floor except in emergencies.
entries.zh: 除紧急情况外，我们不鼓励在车间打私人电话。

entries.en: Let us discuss the delivery options on tomorrow's call.
entries.zh: 我们在明天的电话会议上讨论交货方案。

entries.en: A brief discussion of safety findings will open the meeting.
entries.zh: 会议开始时将简要讨论安全检查结果。

entries.en: A new distribution center will serve the northern region.
entries.zh: 新的配送中心将服务北部地区。

entries.en: The store in the business district closes one hour later on weekdays.
entries.zh: 商业区那家店工作日晚一小时关门。

entries.en: Documentary evidence of insurance must accompany the shipment.
entries.zh: 货物必须附有保险的单据证明。

entries.en: Unsold samples will be donated to a local training college.
entries.zh: 未售出的样品将捐赠给当地一所职业学院。

entries.en: Please double the order of folders for the conference.
entries.zh: 请把会议用的文件夹订量加倍。

entries.en: The sales staff are eager to try the new demonstration kit.
entries.zh: 销售人员很想试用新的演示套件。

entries.en: Consultants earn a bonus when a project is delivered on time.
entries.zh: 项目按时交付时，顾问可获得奖金。

entries.en: The new software should ease the workload at month-end close.
entries.zh: 新软件应能减轻月末结账的工作量。

entries.en: The economics of overnight air freight no longer make sense for this item.
entries.zh: 对该商品而言，隔夜空运在成本上已不再划算。

entries.en: Please edit the press release and send it back by noon.
entries.zh: 请修改新闻稿并在中午前发回。

entries.en: The second edition of the handbook includes the updated travel policy.
entries.zh: 手册第二版已收入更新后的差旅政策。

entries.en: The editor will proofread the annual report before it is printed.
entries.zh: 编辑将在年报付印前校对。

entries.en: The new checklist has effectively reduced packing errors.
entries.zh: 新的检查清单有效减少了包装差错。

entries.en: Thank you for the extra effort during the inventory weekend.
entries.zh: 感谢大家在盘点周末付出的额外努力。

entries.en: Could you elaborate on the training plan in tomorrow's memo?
entries.zh: 能否在明天的备忘录里详细说明培训计划？

entries.en: Shareholders will elect two new directors at the annual meeting.
entries.zh: 股东将在年会上选举两名新董事。

entries.en: Office hours may change around the local election.
entries.zh: 地方选举前后，营业时间可能会调整。

entries.en: The warehouse is switching to electric forklifts this year.

entries.zh: 搬迁方案包含丰厚的住房津贴。

entries.zh: 储藏室无人看管时请上锁。

entries.en: Guests may lodge a complaint at the duty manager's desk.
entries.zh: 客人可向值班经理台提出投诉。

entries.en: Please log every visitor in the reception book.
entries.zh: 请在前台登记簿上记录每位访客。

entries.en: A more logical filing system would save time at month end.
entries.zh: 更合理的归档系统能在月末节省时间。

entries.en: Please use the updated logo on all new stationery.
entries.zh: 所有新文具请使用更新后的标识。

entries.en: If we lose this client, the sales target will be hard to meet.
entries.zh: 如果失去这个客户，销售目标将很难完成。

entries.en: The damaged shipment resulted in a small loss for the quarter.
entries.zh: 这批受损货物导致本季度出现小额亏损。

entries.en: A discount will be offered to loyal customers during the anniversary sale.
entries.zh: 周年促销期间将向忠实客户提供折扣。

entries.en: A working lunch will be served in the meeting room at 12:30.
entries.zh: 12:30将在会议室提供工作午餐。

entries.en: The packing machine will be offline for servicing on Sunday.
entries.zh: 包装机周日将停机检修。

entries.en: Used machinery must be inspected before it is put back into service.
entries.zh: 二手机械重新投入使用前必须检查。

entries.en: An advertisement will run in the trade magazine next month.
entries.zh: 下月将在行业杂志上刊登广告。

entries.en: Please mail the original certificates rather than sending copies.
entries.zh: 请邮寄证书原件，不要只寄复印件。

entries.en: A majority of staff voted for the new shift pattern.
entries.zh: 多数员工投票支持新的排班方式。

entries.en: The manufacturer has issued a service bulletin for this model.
entries.zh: 制造商已针对该型号发布了服务通告。

entries.en: Manufacturing will move to the new plant in September.
entries.zh: 生产将于九月转移到新工厂。

entries.en: The marketing team is preparing a campaign for the spring collection.
entries.zh: 市场团队正在为春季系列准备宣传活动。

entries.en: Training materials will be uploaded the day before the course.
entries.zh: 培训资料将在课程前一天上传。

entries.en: The bond will mature at the end of next year.
entries.zh: 该债券将于明年年底到期。

entries.en: The elevator has a maximum load of 1,000 kilograms.
entries.zh: 电梯最大载重为1000公斤。

entries.en: New safety measures will take effect on Monday.
entries.zh: 新的安全措施将于星期一生效。

entries.en: Please take a second measurement before cutting the panels.
entries.zh: 切割板材前请再测量一次。

entries.en: A mechanic will inspect the delivery vans before the trip.
entries.zh: 机械师将在出发前检查送货车。

entries.en: The delay was caused by a mechanical fault on the packing line.
entries.zh: 延误是由包装线上的机械故障引起的。

entries.en: A feedback mechanism has been added to the customer portal.
entries.zh: 客户门户已增加反馈机制。

entries.en: Please do not speak to the media without approval from communications.
entries.zh: 未经传播部门批准，请勿接受媒体采访。

entries.en: A medical certificate is required for absences longer than two days.
entries.zh: 缺勤超过两天须提供医疗证明。

entries.en: Prescription medicine should be declared at customs.
entries.zh: 处方药物应在海关申报。

entries.en: Gym membership is included in the employee benefits package.
entries.zh: 健身房会员资格包含在员工福利中。

entries.en: Please mention the promotion code when you place the order.
entries.zh: 下单时请提及促销代码。

entries.en: A vegetarian menu is available if requested 48 hours in advance.
entries.zh: 若提前48小时提出，可提供素食菜单。

entries.en: Online merchants must display the return policy clearly.
entries.zh: 网上商户必须清楚展示退货政策。

entries.en: The proposal has merit, but the budget needs more detail.
entries.zh: 该提案有可取之处，但预算还需要更详细。

entries.en: Please leave a message with the receptionist if I am in a meeting.
entries.zh: 如果我在开会，请给前台留言。

entries.en: A safer method of lifting the crates is described in the manual.
entries.zh: 手册中说明了更安全的搬箱方法。

entries.en: The minimum order is 50 units for this product.
entries.zh: 该产品的最低起订量是50件。

entries.en: The trade minister will visit the exhibition on the opening day.
entries.zh: 贸易部长将在开幕日参观展览。

entries.en: The ministry has issued new rules for food labeling.
entries.zh: 该部已发布新的食品标签规定。

entries.en: Only minor changes were made to the seating plan.
entries.zh: 座位安排只做了较小的改动。

entries.en: A minority of shareholders opposed the merger.
entries.zh: 少数股东反对这项合并。

entries.en: The advertisement must not mislead customers about the warranty.
entries.zh: 广告不得在保修方面误导顾客。

entries.en: The trade mission will visit three factories in two days.
entries.zh: 此次商务考察将在两天内参观三家工厂。

entries.en: Please correct the address mistake before the labels are printed.
entries.zh: 在打印标签前请更正地址错误。

entries.en: A mobile payment terminal will be used at the outdoor stall.
entries.zh: 户外摊位将使用移动支付终端。

entries.en: The latest model is lighter than the previous version.
entries.zh: 最新型号比上一版更轻。

entries.en: The modern booking system lets guests change dates online.
entries.zh: 现代预订系统允许客人在线更改日期。

entries.en: We expect a modest increase in bookings this spring.
entries.zh: 我们预计今年春季预订量会有小幅增长。

entries.en: The regulator is reviewing whether the merger would create a monopoly.
entries.zh: 监管机构正在审查此次合并是否会形成垄断。

entries.en: A monthly statement is emailed to every account holder.
entries.zh: 每月对账单会通过电子邮件发给每位账户持有人。

entries.en: A motel near the highway is reserved for the driving team.
entries.zh: 已为驾驶小组在公路附近预订了汽车旅馆。

entries.en: Recognition awards are meant to maintain motivation during a long project.
entries.zh: 表彰奖旨在在长期项目中保持积极性。

entries.en: The survey asks about the main motive for switching suppliers.
entries.zh: 调查询问更换供应商的主要动机。

entries.en: The motor on conveyor three needs to be replaced this weekend.
entries.zh: 三号输送带的电机需在本周末更换。

entries.en: The form allows you to select multiple delivery dates.
entries.zh: 该表格允许选择多个送货日期。

entries.en: The recall applies to nationwide sales of this batch.
entries.zh: 此次召回适用于该批次在全国的销售。

entries.en: A passport photo is necessary for the security badge.
entries.zh: 办理安保胸牌必须提供护照照片。

entries.en: Early booking is a necessity during the conference week.
entries.zh: 会议周期间有必要提前预订。

entries.en: Customer comments were negative about the long checkout line.
entries.zh: 顾客对过长的结账队伍评价负面。

entries.en: Please do not neglect to sign the visitor log.
entries.zh: 请不要忘了在访客登记簿上签字。

entries.en: We will negotiate the delivery schedule with the supplier tomorrow.
entries.zh: 我们明天将与供应商协商交货时间表。

entries.en: Price negotiations are expected to last two days.
entries.zh: 价格谈判预计将持续两天。

entries.en: The new clinic will serve businesses in the neighborhood.
entries.zh: 新诊所将服务附近街区的企业。

entries.en: The printer is not connected to the office network.
entries.zh: 打印机未连接到办公网络。

entries.en: Please keep the announcement in a neutral tone.
entries.zh: 请用中立的语气撰写该公告。

entries.en: The job ad will appear in the Sunday newspaper.
entries.zh: 招聘广告将刊登在周日的报纸上。

entries.en: Nominations for the service award close on Friday.
entries.zh: 服务奖的提名于周五截止。

entries.en: The cafeteria is normally open until 7 p.m. on weekdays.
entries.zh: 食堂工作日通常开放到晚上7点。

entries.en: Please bring a notebook to the workshop.
entries.zh: 请带一本笔记本参加研讨。

entries.en: Written notice of a price change will be sent 30 days in advance.
entries.zh: 价格变更的书面通知将提前30天发出。

entries.en: We have received numerous requests to extend the store hours.
entries.zh: 我们收到许多要求延长营业时间的申请。

entries.en: A nurse is on duty in the staff clinic until 5 p.m.
entries.zh: 员工诊所的护士值班至下午5点。

entries.en: If there is no objection, the minutes will be approved as drafted.
entries.zh: 如果没有异议，会议记录将按草稿通过。

entries.en: The contract obliges the supplier to give 14 days' notice of delays.
entries.zh: 合同要求供应商在延误时提前14天通知。

entries.en: All visitors must observe the safety rules in the production area.
entries.zh: 所有访客必须遵守生产区的安全规定。

entries.en: An observer from the certification body will attend the audit.
entries.zh: 认证机构的观察员将出席此次审计。

entries.en: A missing permit is the main obstacle to starting construction.
entries.zh: 缺少许可是开工的主要障碍。

entries.en: It should be obvious from the sign that this door is an emergency exit.
entries.zh: 从标识上应能明显看出这扇门是紧急出口。

entries.en: The shipment was obviously damaged and should not have been accepted.
entries.zh: 这批货明显已损坏，本不该签收。

entries.en: Name badges should be worn on formal occasions in the plant.
entries.zh: 在工厂的正式场合应佩戴姓名牌。

entries.en: Occasional overtime may be required at month end.
entries.zh: 月末可能需要偶尔加班。

entries.en: The ferry is occasionally cancelled because of high winds.
entries.zh: 渡轮偶尔会因大风取消。

entries.en: Please state your occupation on the visa form.
entries.zh: 请在签证表上填写职业。

entries.en: If a delay occurs, please notify the customer the same day.
entries.zh: 如果出现延误，请在当天通知客户。

entries.en: This is the second occurrence of a mislabeled shipment this month.
entries.zh: 这是本月第二次出现标签贴错的货物。

entries.en: We are pleased to offer you the position of shift supervisor.
entries.zh: 我们很高兴录用你为班次主管。

entries.en: A customs officer may open the crates for inspection.
entries.zh: 海关官员可能会开箱检查。

entries.en: An official announcement will be posted on the intranet at noon.
entries.zh: 官方公告将于中午发布在内网上。

entries.en: The new branch will officially open on the first Monday in May.
entries.zh: 新分店将于五月的第一个星期一正式开业。

entries.en: We have an opening for a part-time cashier on weekends.
entries.zh: 我们有一个周末兼职收银员的空缺。

entries.en: Night-time operation of the loading dock will start next month.
entries.zh: 装卸台的夜间作业将于下月开始。

entries.en: Please ask the switchboard operator to connect you to purchasing.
entries.zh: 请让总机接线员帮你转到采购部。

entries.en: In our opinion, the bid should include a longer warranty.
entries.zh: 我们认为投标应包含更长的保修期。

entries.en: Our main opponent in this tender is a local contractor.
entries.zh: 这次招标中我们的主要对手是一家本地承包商。

entries.en: Several residents oppose the plan to extend store hours.
entries.zh: 一些居民反对延长营业时间的计划。

entries.en: The visitor parking lot is opposite the main entrance.
entries.zh: 访客停车场在正门对面。

entries.en: There was little opposition to the new flexible-hours policy.
entries.zh: 对新的弹性工时政策几乎没有反对意见。

entries.en: Staff may opt for a bus pass instead of a parking space.
entries.zh: 员工可以选择公交卡，而不是停车位。

entries.en: An oral briefing will be given to the night shift at 9 p.m.
entries.zh: 晚上9点将向夜班作口头情况说明。

entries.en: Ordinary wear is not covered by the equipment warranty.
entries.zh: 正常磨损不在设备保修范围内。

entries.en: The organization has offices in four countries.
entries.zh: 该机构在四个国家设有办事处。

entries.en: The organizer will email a floor plan the day before the show.
entries.zh: 主办方将在展会前一天通过电子邮件发送平面图。

entries.en: The origin of the raw materials must be stated on the label.
entries.zh: 原材料产地必须在标签上标明。

entries.en: Please keep the original receipt for your records.
entries.zh: 请保留收据原件以作记录。

entries.en: The meeting was originally set for Monday, but it was moved to Tuesday.
entries.zh: 会议原定周一举行，后改到周二。

entries.en: The complaint originated in the west-coast store.
entries.zh: 该投诉来自西海岸那家店。

entries.en: We will share the outcome of the audit with all managers.
entries.zh: 我们将向所有经理通报审计结果。

entries.en: Overall sales were slightly higher than last year.
entries.zh: 总体销售略高于去年。

entries.en: Please avoid an overlap between the two training sessions.
entries.zh: 请避免两场培训的时间重叠。

entries.en: The documents were sent overnight and should arrive by morning.
entries.zh: 文件已隔夜寄出，应在上午到达。

entries.en: A sudden rush of online orders overwhelmed the packing team.
entries.zh: 突然涌入的在线订单使打包组应接不暇。

entries.en: The client still owes an outstanding balance of 1,200 dollars.
entries.zh: 客户仍欠1,200美元的未付余额。

entries.en: The building owner has approved the new signage.
entries.zh: 业主已批准新的招牌。

entries.en: Please pack the glassware with extra foam.
entries.zh: 请给玻璃器皿多加泡沫包装。

entries.en: Each guest will receive a packet of information at registration.
entries.zh: 每位客人在登记时都会收到一包资料。

entries.en: Please order an extra pair of safety gloves for the new hire.
entries.zh: 请为新员工多订一副安全手套。

entries.en: Please print the agenda on recycled paper.
entries.zh: 请用再生纸打印议程。

entries.en: A parallel test of the new system will run for two weeks.
entries.zh: 新系统的并行测试将进行两周。

entries.en: Visitor parking is free for the first two hours.
entries.zh: 访客停车前两小时免费。

entries.en: A partial refund will be issued for the unused nights.
entries.zh: 未入住的晚数将办理部分退款。

entries.en: Each participant should bring a photo for the badge.
entries.zh: 每位参与者应带一张照片办理胸牌。

entries.en: Participation in the safety drill is mandatory.
entries.zh: 参加安全演练是强制性的。

entries.en: This delay is particularly serious because of the product launch.
entries.zh: 由于产品即将发布，这次延误尤其严重。

entries.en: The two firms announced a partnership to share warehouse space.
entries.zh: 两家公司宣布合作共享仓库空间。

entries.en: Please keep the passage to the fire exit clear.
entries.zh: 请保持通往消防出口的通道畅通。

entries.en: Passengers traveling with oversized luggage should check in early.
entries.zh: 携带超大行李的乘客应提前办理登机手续。

entries.en: Your passport must be valid for at least six months.
entries.zh: 护照有效期必须至少还有六个月。

entries.en: A software patch will be installed after closing time.
entries.zh: 打烊后将安装软件补丁。

entries.en: Thank you for your patience while we repair the payment system.
entries.zh: 感谢您在我们维修支付系统时的耐心等待。

entries.en: The clinic can see walk-in patients after 3 p.m.
entries.zh: 诊所下午3点后可接待未经预约的病人。

entries.en: A regular pattern of late deliveries has been reported.
entries.zh: 已有报告称经常出现延迟交货的情况。

entries.en: Payment is due within 30 days of the invoice date.
entries.zh: 付款应在发票日期起30天内完成。

entries.en: Please avoid deliveries during peak traffic hours.
entries.zh: 请避免在交通高峰时段送货。

entries.en: Peer feedback will be collected before the annual review.
entries.zh: 年评前将收集同级反馈。

entries.en: A small percentage of items are set aside for quality checks.
entries.zh: 一小部分商品会留作质量抽查。

entries.en: Please wait until we perfect the wording before sending the letter.
entries.zh: 请等我们完善措辞后再寄出这封信。

entries.en: Team performance improved after the new schedule was introduced.
entries.zh: 新排班实行后，团队表现有所提升。

entries.en: The promotional period ends on the last day of the month.
entries.zh: 促销期于该月最后一天结束。

entries.en: Periodic inspections of the elevators are required by law.
entries.zh: 法律要求对电梯进行定期检查。

entries.en: You need written permission to photograph the production line.
entries.zh: 拍摄生产线需要书面许可。

entries.en: If the error persists after a restart, call the help desk.
entries.zh: 如果重启后错误仍然存在，请致电服务台。

entries.en: From the customer's perspective, a shorter delivery window is essential.
entries.zh: 从客户的角度看，更短的交货窗口至关重要。

entries.en: Please photograph the damaged carton before you unpack it.
entries.zh: 拆箱前请拍下受损纸箱的照片。

entries.en: A physical inventory will be taken on Sunday.
entries.zh: 周日将进行实物盘点。

entries.en: The company pioneered same-day delivery in this market.
entries.zh: 该公司在这个市场开创了当日达服务。

entries.en: The event planner will confirm the seating chart tomorrow.
entries.zh: 活动策划人明天将确认座位表。

entries.en: The new plant will employ 200 people in the first year.
entries.zh: 新工厂第一年将雇用200人。

entries.en: Please use plastic sleeves to protect the original certificates.
entries.zh: 请用塑料封套保护证书原件。

entries.en: The train for the factory shuttle leaves from platform 3.
entries.zh: 前往工厂的班车火车从3号站台开出。

entries.en: An adapter is needed to plug the projector into this outlet.
entries.zh: 要把投影仪插入这个插座，需要转接头。

entries.en: A polite reminder will be sent if the invoice is still unpaid.
entries.zh: 若发票仍未付款，将发送一封礼貌的提醒。

entries.en: We will poll staff about preferred shift times.
entries.zh: 我们将向员工调查更倾向的班次时间。

entries.en: The new filters are designed to reduce air pollution from the plant.
entries.zh: 新过滤器旨在减少工厂的空气污染。

entries.en: The early train is popular with commuters, so reserve a seat.
entries.zh: 早班火车很受通勤者欢迎，请预订座位。

entries.en: A portable scanner will be used at the outdoor registration desk.
entries.zh: 户外登记台将使用便携式扫描仪。

entries.en: A portion of the proceeds will be donated to the staff fund.
entries.zh: 一部分收入将捐给员工基金。

entries.en: The position will remain open until a suitable candidate is found.
entries.zh: 在找到合适人选之前，该职位将保持空缺。

entries.en: Customer feedback on the new layout has been largely positive.
entries.zh: 顾客对新布局的反馈大多是积极的。

entries.en: There is a possibility that the flight will be delayed by fog.
entries.zh: 航班有可能因雾延误。

entries.en: Please put the safety poster next to the staff entrance.
entries.zh: 请把安全海报贴在员工入口旁边。

entries.en: We may have to postpone the site visit if the storm continues.
entries.zh: 如果风暴持续，我们可能不得不推迟现场考察。

entries.en: A more powerful pump is needed for the upper floors.
entries.zh: 楼上需要一台功率更大的泵。

entries.en: The workshop includes a practical session on packing fragile goods.
entries.zh: 研讨班包含一节关于易碎品包装的实训。

entries.en: The spare room is practically ready for the visiting auditors.
entries.zh: 备用房间差不多已为来访审计人员准备好。

entries.en: It is our practice to confirm bookings in writing.
entries.zh: 书面确认预订是我们的惯例。

entries.en: Please give a precise count of the unsold units.
entries.zh: 请提供未售出产品的精确数量。

entries.en: The shuttle leaves precisely at 7:10 a.m.
entries.zh: 班车在早上7:10准时出发。

entries.en: Analysts predict higher demand for compact models next year.
entries.zh: 分析师预测明年对紧凑型产品的需求会更高。

entries.en: Our earlier prediction of a summer slowdown was too pessimistic.
entries.zh: 我们先前对夏季业务放缓的预测过于悲观。

entries.en: Most clients prefer morning meetings to late-afternoon ones.
entries.zh: 大多数客户更喜欢上午开会，而不是傍晚。

entries.en: Please indicate your seating preference on the registration form.
entries.zh: 请在报名表上注明座位偏好。

entries.en: No visitors may enter the premises without a badge.
entries.zh: 没有证件的访客不得进入经营场所。

entries.en: Preparation for the audit should begin two weeks in advance.
entries.zh: 审计准备工作应提前两周开始。

entries.en: Please prepare name cards for all the speakers.
entries.zh: 请为所有演讲人准备名片。

entries.en: Your presence is requested at Friday's client briefing.
entries.zh: 请出席周五的客户情况说明会。

entries.en: Please present your ticket and passport at the gate.
entries.zh: 请在登机口出示机票和护照。

entries.en: The sales presentation will last no more than 20 minutes.
entries.zh: 销售演示不超过20分钟。

entries.en: Please preserve all packing materials until the inspection is finished.
entries.zh: 在检查完成前请保存所有包装材料。

entries.en: The president of the association will open the conference.
entries.zh: 协会主席将宣布会议开幕。

entries.en: A press briefing will be held after the product launch.
entries.zh: 产品发布后将举行新闻说明会。

entries.en: There is pressure to finish the renovation before the holiday season.
entries.zh: 必须在假日季前完成装修，时间压力很大。

entries.en: Safety gates are installed to prevent unauthorized entry.

entries.zh: 展览周期间将开行专班接驳车。

entries.zh: 请给出技术员可以上门的具体时间。

entries.en: Please do not stack boxes in front of the fire exit.

entries.zh: 房间按酒店集团制定的标准清洁。

entries.en: Please staple the receipts to the expense form.
entries.zh: 请把收据订在报销单上。

entries.en: A shuttle meets every train at the central station.
entries.zh: 中央车站每趟火车都有班车接驳。

entries.zh: 最新统计数字显示客户投诉有所下降。

entries.en: The new refund process is more straightforward than the old one.
entries.zh: 新的退款流程比旧的更简单明了。

entries.zh: 这次投标的一个关键优势是我们的本地服务团队。

entries.zh: 如果零件迟到，翻修可能会延至七月初。

entries.zh: 运输罢工使送货延误了两天。

entries.en: Subsequent orders will be shipped from the new warehouse.
entries.zh: 随后的订单将从新仓库发货。

entries.en: The error was found and subsequently corrected on the invoice.
entries.zh: 错误被发现后，随后在发票上作了更正。

entries.en: A new store will open in the northern suburb next month.
entries.zh: 下月将在北郊开一家新店。

entries.zh: 郊区线路晚上8点后的班次较少。

entries.zh: 试销很成功，正式发布将于五月进行。

entries.en: The successful bidder will be notified in writing.
entries.zh: 中标者将收到书面通知。

entries.en: The system was successfully upgraded over the weekend.
entries.zh: 系统已在周末成功升级。

entries.en: Any suggestion for improving the checkout process is welcome.
entries.zh: 欢迎提出改进结账流程的建议。

entries.zh: 客户会议请穿深色套装。

entries.zh: 超大手提箱须在超大行李柜台托运。

entries.zh: 已为董事会预订了二楼的会议套房。

entries.en: A one-page summary is attached for busy readers.
entries.zh: 为方便繁忙的读者，附上一页摘要。

entries.en: The industry summit will be held in Singapore this year.
entries.zh: 今年的行业峰会将在新加坡举行。

entries.en: The supermarket has asked for twice-weekly deliveries.
entries.zh: 超市要求改为每周送货两次。

entries.en: Trainees may operate the machine only under supervision.
entries.zh: 培训生只有在监督下才能操作这台机器。

entries.zh: 请立即向当班主管报告泄漏情况。

entries.zh: 面板表面的划痕不在保修范围内。

entries.en: Small shops may not survive a long road closure.
entries.zh: 长期封路可能让小店难以维持。

entries.en: If you suspect a billing error, please contact accounts the same day.
entries.zh: 如果怀疑账单有误，请在当天联系会计部门。

entries.en: We may suspend deliveries if the invoice remains unpaid.
entries.zh: 如果发票仍未支付，我们可能暂停送货。

entries.en: A temporary suspension of the shuttle is planned during the road work.
entries.zh: 道路施工期间计划暂时停开班车。

entries.en: Please report any suspicious packages to security.
entries.zh: 如发现任何可疑包裹，请向安保报告。

entries.zh: 将于五月开始对安全程序进行系统审查。

entries.en: A task force was formed to tackle the packing backlog.
entries.zh: 已成立专项小组来处理打包积压。

entries.en: A common tactic is to offer a discount for early payment.
entries.zh: 常用策略是为提前付款提供折扣。

entries.en: We can tailor the training program to each department's needs.
entries.zh: 我们可以按各部门的需求定制培训计划。

entries.en: The firm is trying to retain talent in the engineering team.
entries.zh: 公司正努力留住工程团队中的人才。

entries.zh: 一位有才能的设计师已加入包装团队。

entries.en: Please tape the cartons securely before they are stacked.

entries.zh: 请在发票上把地方税单独列为一行。

entries.en: A taxi stand is located just outside the hotel entrance.
entries.zh: 酒店门口就有出租车站。

entries.zh: 技术故障推迟了在线会议的开始。

entries.en: The manual describes a safer lifting technique.
entries.zh: 手册介绍了一种更安全的搬运技巧。

entries.en: New scanning technology has shortened the checkout time.
entries.zh: 新的扫描技术缩短了结账时间。

entries.en: Please telephone the help desk if the printer goes offline.
entries.zh: 如果打印机掉线，请打电话给服务台。

entries.en: There is a tendency for online orders to rise on Sunday evenings.
entries.zh: 周日晚上在线订单往往增加。

entries.zh: 仓库主管将在保险听证会上作证。

entries.zh: 这批纺织品在运输途中必须保持干燥。

entries.zh: 在发送报告前请彻底核对数字。

entries.zh: 洪水对一楼储藏室构成威胁。

entries.zh: 超过审批门槛的发票必须由总监签字。

entries.zh: 所有海外差旅必须通过差旅台预订。
