entries.zh: 管理层已批准盘点周末加班。

entries.en: Please speak to the duty manager if you need a refund above 100 dollars.
entries.zh: 如果退款超过100美元，请找值班经理。

entries.en: We plan to market the compact model to small hotels first.
entries.zh: 我们计划先向小型酒店推销这款紧凑型产品。

entries.en: The weekly meeting has been moved to Thursday at 10 a.m.
entries.zh: 周会已改到周四上午10点。

entries.en: Each team member should bring a laptop to the workshop.
entries.zh: 每位团队成员参加研讨时都应带上笔记本电脑。

entries.en: The finance office is on the second floor, next to reception.
entries.zh: 财务办公室在二楼，前台旁边。

entries.en: Please place the order before the supplier's cutoff time.
entries.zh: 请在供应商截止时间前下订单。

entries.en: Visitors may park in the marked spaces behind the building.
entries.zh: 访客可以把车停在楼后的指定车位。

entries.en: Both parties have signed the revised delivery schedule.
entries.zh: 双方均已签署修订后的交货时间表。

entries.en: You will need a visitor pass to enter the production area.
entries.zh: 进入生产区需要访客通行证。

entries.en: Invoices are usually paid within 30 days of receipt.
entries.zh: 发票通常在收到后30天内支付。

entries.en: Prices will rise by three percent on the first of May.
entries.zh: 价格将于5月1日上涨百分之三。

entries.en: Personal calls should be made during the break, not on the shop floor.
entries.zh: 私人电话应在休息时打，不要在车间打。

entries.en: Please phone the warehouse if the truck will be more than 15 minutes late.
entries.zh: 如果卡车晚到超过15分钟，请打电话给仓库。

entries.en: The launch plan will be reviewed at Friday's meeting.
entries.zh: 发布计划将在周五的会议上审阅。

entries.en: Please post the new opening hours on the staff noticeboard.
entries.zh: 请把新的营业时间张贴在员工公告栏上。

entries.en: A power cut stopped the packing line for forty minutes.
entries.zh: 一次停电使包装线停了四十分钟。

entries.en: The new price list takes effect on Monday.
entries.zh: 新价目表于星期一生效。

entries.en: Please print two copies of the signed contract.
entries.zh: 请打印两份已签字的合同。

entries.en: If there is a problem with the badge reader, call facilities.
entries.zh: 如果门禁读卡器有问题，请致电总务部门。

entries.en: The exhibition is open to the public on Saturday.
entries.zh: 展览周六对公众开放。

entries.en: Please write your question on the card and hand it to the moderator.
entries.zh: 请把问题写在卡片上交给主持人。

entries.en: Please record the batch number on every quality form.
entries.zh: 请在每份质量表上记录批次号。

entries.en: A short incident report should be filed before the end of the shift.
entries.zh: 应在本班次结束前提交简短的事故报告。

entries.en: Please store the samples in a cool, dry room.
entries.zh: 请把样品存放在阴凉干燥的房间。

entries.en: The packing team will work an extra hour during the sale.
entries.zh: 促销期间，打包团队将加班一小时。

entries.en: A drop test will be performed on the new packaging.
entries.zh: 将对新包装进行跌落测试。

entries.en: Please return all tools to the board after the repair.
entries.zh: 维修结束后请把所有工具放回工具板。

entries.en: The first topic on the agenda is the warehouse move.
entries.zh: 议程上的第一项是仓库搬迁。

entries.en: The total on the invoice does not include installation.
entries.zh: 发票总额不包括安装费。

entries.en: New cashiers will be trained on the refund process this week.
entries.zh: 新收银员本周将接受退款流程培训。

entries.en: Please treat confidential files as restricted documents.
entries.zh: 请把机密文件当作限制级文件处理。

entries.en: Special treatment of fragile goods is described in the packing guide.
entries.zh: 包装指南中说明了易碎品的特殊处理方法。

entries.en: The sales trip to Osaka has been confirmed for next week.
entries.zh: 下周去大阪的销售出差已经确认。

entries.en: A typical order from this client is 200 units.
entries.zh: 该客户的典型订单是200件。

entries.en: Replacements are typically shipped within two business days.
entries.zh: 替换件通常在两个工作日内寄出。

entries.en: We are unable to deliver on Sunday because the warehouse is closed.
entries.zh: 仓库周日不开放，我们无法送货。

entries.en: A two-week delay would be unacceptable for the launch.
entries.zh: 两周延误对发布来说是不能接受的。

entries.en: The arrival time is still uncertain because of the storm.
entries.zh: 由于风暴，到达时间仍不确定。

entries.en: I understand that the parts will arrive on Tuesday morning.
entries.zh: 我了解到零件将于周二上午到达。

entries.en: We reached an understanding on the new delivery schedule.
entries.zh: 我们就新的交货时间表达成了谅解。

entries.en: It is unfortunate that the samples were delayed, and we will ship replacements today.
entries.zh: 样品延误令人遗憾，我们今天将寄出替换件。

entries.en: Unfortunately, the 4 p.m. shuttle is already full.
entries.zh: 遗憾的是，下午4点的班车已经满员。

entries.en: Each unit is packed with a charger and a user guide.
entries.zh: 每台设备都配有充电器和使用指南。

entries.en: The two departments will unite to handle the product recall.
entries.zh: 两个部门将联合处理这次产品召回。

entries.en: The inspection result will be emailed to the plant manager.
entries.zh: 检验结果将通过电子邮件发给厂长。

entries.en: We expect a rise in bookings after the conference.
entries.zh: 我们预计会议后预订量会上升。

entries.en: The shuttle will run every 20 minutes during the exhibition.
entries.zh: 展览期间班车每20分钟一班。

entries.en: Please set the meeting room for 16 people.
entries.zh: 请把会议室布置成16人座位。

entries.en: A trade show in March will feature the new scanner.
entries.zh: 三月的展会将展示新的扫描器。

entries.en: A single tracking number covers all three cartons.
entries.zh: 一个运单号涵盖全部三个纸箱。

entries.en: Please confirm the crate size before we book the truck.
entries.zh: 预订卡车前请确认板条箱尺寸。

entries.en: The first month of sales has been solid, above the forecast.
entries.zh: 第一个月的销售很稳，高于预测。

entries.en: Please do not spend more than the approved travel budget.
entries.zh: 请不要超过已批准的差旅预算。

entries.en: We will split the large order across two shipments.
entries.zh: 我们将把大订单分成两批运送。

entries.en: Our stand is in Hall B, near the main entrance.
entries.zh: 我们的展位在B厅，靠近正门。

entries.en: The workshop will start at 9 a.m. sharp.
entries.zh: 研讨班将于上午9点准时开始。

entries.en: Please state the purchase-order number on every invoice.
entries.zh: 请在每张发票上注明采购订单号。

entries.en: Your hotel stay includes breakfast and airport transfer.
entries.zh: 你的酒店住宿包含早餐和机场接送。

entries.en: The next step is to send the revised quote to the client.
entries.zh: 下一步是把修订后的报价发给客户。

entries.en: The shuttle makes a stop at the commuter rail station.
entries.zh: 班车会在通勤铁路车站停靠。

entries.en: A feasibility study will be completed before we lease the site.
entries.zh: 在租赁场地前将完成可行性研究。

entries.en: The offer is subject to final credit approval.
entries.zh: 该报价须以最终信用审批为准。

entries.en: The early completion of the renovation was a welcome surprise.
entries.zh: 装修提前完工是一个令人高兴的意外。

entries.en: Please reserve a table for six in the hotel restaurant.
entries.zh: 请在酒店餐厅预订一张六人桌。

entries.en: A confirmation text will be sent when the technician is on the way.
entries.zh: 技术员出发时会发送确认短信。

entries.en: The theme of this year's conference is digital customer service.
entries.zh: 今年会议的主题是数字化客户服务。

entries.en: Please get in touch with the travel desk if your flight changes.
entries.zh: 如果航班有变，请联系差旅台。

entries.en: The warranty does not cover damage caused by incorrect installation.
entries.zh: 保修不包括因安装不当造成的损坏。

entries.en: Please estimate the cost of overnight shipping before you book it.
entries.zh: 预订隔夜运输前请先估算费用。

entries.en: The job will be posted on the careers page tonight.
entries.zh: 该职位今晚将发布在招聘页面上。

entries.en: Each item on the invoice should match the packing list.
entries.zh: 发票上的每一项都应与装箱单一致。

entries.en: Please list any damaged items on the delivery note.
entries.zh: 请在送货单上列出任何损坏的物品。

entries.en: We need two extra cashiers for the weekend sale.
entries.zh: 周末促销我们需要再增加两名收银员。

entries.en: Please note that the lobby will be closed for painting on Friday.
entries.zh: 请注意，大厅周五将因粉刷关闭。

entries.en: Please quote your membership number when you call.
entries.zh: 打电话时请报上会员号码。

entries.en: The store will open an hour earlier during the sale.
entries.zh: 促销期间商店将提前一小时开门。

entries.en: The cancellation policy is explained on page two of the brochure.
entries.zh: 取消政策在手册第二页有说明。

entries.en: A replacement part will be shipped tomorrow morning.
entries.zh: 替换零件将于明天上午寄出。

entries.en: Please place the fragile cartons on the top of the stack.
entries.zh: 请把易碎纸箱放在堆垛顶部。

entries.en: Please keep the airfare receipt for your travel claim.
entries.zh: 请保留机票费收据以便报销差旅。

entries.en: The boarding-gate for the Chicago flight has been changed to 19.
entries.zh: 飞往芝加哥的航班登机口已改为19号。

entries.en: Oversized luggage should be taken to the check-in-desk, not the gate.
entries.zh: 超大行李应送到值机柜台，不要带到登机口。

entries.en: Please ask the duty-manager if you need a refund above the cashier's limit.
entries.zh: 如果退款超过收银员权限，请找值班经理。

entries.en: A parking-permit can be collected from facilities on your first day.
entries.zh: 停车证可在入职第一天到总务部门领取。

entries.en: There will be a 15-minute coffee-break after the first session.
entries.zh: 第一场结束后将有15分钟茶歇。

entries.en: A staff-meeting will be held in the canteen at 8:30 a.m.
entries.zh: 上午8:30将在食堂召开员工会议。

entries.en: My extension-number is 2451 if you need to reach me directly.
entries.zh: 如果需要直接找我，我的分机号是2451。

entries.en: A toll-free number is printed on the back of the warranty card.
entries.zh: 保修卡背面印有免费电话号码。

entries.en: Please mute the speakerphone when you are not talking.
entries.zh: 不发言时请把免提电话静音。

entries.en: Each call-center desk has a headset and a spare battery.
entries.zh: 每个呼叫中心工位都有耳麦和备用电池。

entries.en: A webcam is available in the small meeting room for remote interviews.
entries.zh: 小会议室有网络摄像头，可用于远程面试。

entries.en: Do not share your password with anyone, including IT contractors.
entries.zh: 请不要把密码告诉任何人，包括信息技术承包人员。

entries.en: Your username is your work email address.
entries.zh: 你的用户名就是工作邮箱地址。

entries.en: A failed login will lock the account after five attempts.
entries.zh: 连续五次登录失败将锁定账户。

entries.en: Please logout of the shared computer when you finish.
entries.zh: 用完共享电脑后请退出登录。

entries.en: The firewall blocked the attachment, so please send a link instead.
entries.zh: 防火墙拦截了附件，请改发链接。

entries.en: The office router will be replaced this weekend.
entries.zh: 办公室路由器将于本周末更换。

entries.en: The budget worksheet is in the shared finance folder.
entries.zh: 预算工作表在共享的财务文件夹中。

entries.en: The slide-deck should be no longer than 12 pages.
entries.zh: 幻灯片文稿不应超过12页。

entries.en: A printout of the seating plan is on the lectern.
entries.zh: 讲桌上有一份座位表的打印件。

entries.en: Do not use paperclips on documents that will go through the scanner.
entries.zh: 不要在将要扫描的文件上使用回形针。

entries.en: The signed contracts are in the locked filing-cabinet.
entries.zh: 已签字的合同放在上锁的文件柜里。

entries.en: A replacement office-chair can be requested from facilities.
entries.zh: 可向总务部门申请更换办公椅。

entries.en: Please switch off the desk-lamp when you leave.
entries.zh: 离开时请关掉台灯。

entries.en: A new name-plate will be placed on the door after the move.
entries.zh: 搬迁后会在门上安装新的姓名牌。

entries.en: A fire-extinguisher is located next to each stairwell.
entries.zh: 每个楼梯间旁边都有灭火器。

entries.en: The first-aid-kit is on the wall behind the reception desk.
entries.zh: 急救箱挂在前台后面的墙上。

entries.en: Boxes must never be stored in front of an emergency-exit.
entries.zh: 紧急出口前不得堆放箱子。

entries.en: The smoke-detector in the kitchen will be tested on Sunday.
entries.zh: 厨房的烟雾探测器将于周日测试。

entries.en: After the alarm, please go to the assembly-point in the north parking lot.
entries.zh: 警报响起后，请到北停车场的集合点。

entries.en: Please use the time-clock at the staff entrance, not the visitor gate.
entries.zh: 请在员工入口的考勤钟打卡，不要在访客门。

entries.en: Don't forget to punch-in before you start your shift.
entries.zh: 开始上班前别忘了打卡。

entries.en: You should punch-out only after the handover is complete.
entries.zh: 交接完成后再下班打卡。

entries.en: The badge-reader at the side door is out of order; please use the main entrance.
entries.zh: 侧门的门禁读卡器出了故障，请走正门。

entries.en: A replacement access-card can be issued by security on the same day.
entries.zh: 安保可以在当天补发门禁卡。

entries.en: If your key-card does not work, please return to the front desk.
entries.zh: 如果房卡刷不开，请回前台。

entries.en: Only the duty manager may use the master-key.
entries.zh: 只有值班经理可以使用总钥匙。

entries.en: A pair of glasses was handed in at the lost-and-found.
entries.zh: 有一副眼镜被交到了失物招领处。

entries.en: Please include the area-code when you write the contact number.
entries.zh: 填写联系电话时请加上区号。

entries.en: Broadband in the meeting rooms will be upgraded this month.
entries.zh: 会议室的宽带将于本月升级。

entries.en: If the wireless signal is weak, please use the ethernet cable on the table.
entries.zh: 如果无线信号弱，请使用桌上的以太网线。

entries.en: The email server will be offline for maintenance at midnight.
entries.zh: 邮件服务器将于午夜停机维护。

entries.en: Customer records are stored in a secure database.
entries.zh: 客户记录储存在安全数据库中。

entries.en: Please put the cap back on the whiteboard-marker after the meeting.
entries.zh: 会后请把白板笔的笔帽盖上。

entries.en: A staple-remover is in the top drawer of the copy room.
entries.zh: 起钉器在复印室最上面的抽屉里。

entries.en: Please file the invoices in the hanging-folder marked 'October'.
entries.zh: 请把发票归入标有“十月”的悬挂文件夹。

entries.en: A 'meeting in progress' door-sign should be used during interviews.
entries.zh: 面试期间应使用“会议进行中”的门上标示。

entries.en: The sprinkler system will be inspected by the fire officer.
entries.zh: 消防官员将检查喷淋系统。

entries.en: A roll-call will be taken at the assembly-point after the drill.
entries.zh: 演练后将在集合点点名。

entries.en: Your access-card is needed to pass the turnstile.
entries.zh: 通过旋转闸门需要门禁卡。

entries.en: A security-camera covers the loading dock at all times.
entries.zh: 装卸台全天都有监控摄像头覆盖。

entries.en: A spare-key for the storeroom is held by the duty manager.
entries.zh: 储藏室的备用钥匙由值班经理保管。

entries.en: The coffee-machine in the break room will be serviced tomorrow.
entries.zh: 休息室的咖啡机明天将检修。

entries.en: A notice about the staff picnic is posted by the water-cooler.
entries.zh: 饮水机旁贴有员工野餐通知。

entries.en: Please do not leave food in the microwave after heating.
entries.zh: 加热后请不要把食物留在微波炉里。

entries.en: The vending-machine on the third floor now accepts the staff card.
entries.zh: 三楼的自动售货机现在可以使用员工卡。

entries.en: Ideas for improving the cafeteria can be placed in the suggestion-box.
entries.zh: 改进食堂的建议可以投入意见箱。

entries.en: The shift roster is posted on the noticeboard by the staff entrance.
entries.zh: 班次表贴在员工入口旁的公告栏上。

entries.en: Please put signed forms in my in-tray, not on the chair.
entries.zh: 请把已签字的表格放进我的收文盘，不要放在椅子上。

entries.en: The courier will collect anything left in the out-tray at 4 p.m.
entries.zh: 快递员下午4点会来取发文盘里的文件。

entries.en: Confidential drafts should go into the paper-shredder.
entries.zh: 机密草稿应放入碎纸机。

entries.en: The copier is low on toner; a spare cartridge is in the supply closet.
entries.zh: 复印机碳粉不足，备用墨盒在用品柜里。

entries.en: Please order an ink-cartridge before the printer runs out.
entries.zh: 请在打印机用完之前订购墨盒。

entries.en: A letter-opener is in the top drawer if you need to open the mail.
entries.zh: 需要拆信时，开信刀在最上面的抽屉里。

entries.en: Please seal the cartons with packing-tape, not regular office tape.
entries.zh: 请用包装胶带封箱，不要用普通办公胶带。

entries.en: Glass samples should be covered in bubble-wrap before shipping.
entries.zh: 玻璃样品寄出前应包上气泡膜。

entries.en: Use packing-peanuts to fill the empty space in the crate.
entries.zh: 请用泡沫填充颗粒填满板条箱的空隙。

entries.en: Only certified staff may operate the forklift.
entries.zh: 只有经过认证的员工才能操作叉车。

entries.en: Trucks should not idle at the loading-dock for more than ten minutes.
entries.zh: 卡车在装卸台怠速停留不得超过十分钟。

entries.en: Please keep the loading-bay clear of empty pallets.
entries.zh: 请不要在装卸区堆放空托盘。

entries.en: The pallets should be shrink-wrapped before they leave the warehouse.
entries.zh: 托盘离开仓库前应进行收缩膜包装。

entries.en: Please check that the container seal number matches the documents.
entries.zh: 请核对集装箱封条号是否与文件一致。

entries.en: The machine will be shipped in a wooden crate.
entries.zh: 这台机器将装在木板箱中运送。

entries.en: The driver cannot leave without a signed manifest.
entries.zh: 没有已签字的货单，司机不能离开。

entries.en: Los Angeles is the port-of-entry for this shipment.
entries.zh: 这批货的入境口岸是洛杉矶。

entries.en: Please confirm the port-of-departure on the bill of lading.
entries.zh: 请确认提单上的启运港。

entries.en: The estimated-time-of-arrival has been pushed back by six hours.
entries.zh: 预计到达时间已推迟六小时。

entries.en: The estimated-time-of-departure will be posted on the board at noon.
entries.zh: 预计出发时间将于中午公布在信息牌上。

entries.en: The gate-agent will call passengers who need special assistance first.
entries.zh: 登机口服务人员会先呼叫需要特殊协助的乘客。

entries.en: You can pay the excess-baggage fee at the ticket-counter.
entries.zh: 超重行李费可在售票柜台支付。

entries.en: Please fasten your seat-belt until the sign is switched off.
entries.zh: 请系好安全带，直到指示灯关闭。

entries.en: Place smaller bags in the overhead-locker, not in the aisle.
entries.zh: 小包请放入头顶行李舱，不要放在过道上。

entries.en: In-flight meals will not be served on this short route.
entries.zh: 这条短途航线不提供机上餐食。

entries.en: A 40-minute connection-time is too short in this airport.
entries.zh: 在这个机场，40分钟的转机时间太短。

entries.en: Boarding-time is 30 minutes before departure.
entries.zh: 登机时间是起飞前30分钟。

entries.en: Please check the departure-board for the latest gate number.
entries.zh: 请在出发信息牌上查看最新的登机口号码。

entries.en: The driver will meet you in the arrivals-hall, not at the curb.
entries.zh: 司机会在到达大厅接你，而不是在路边。

entries.en: Currency-exchange is available in the lobby from 7 a.m.
entries.zh: 大厅从早上7点起提供货币兑换。

entries.en: A safety-deposit box is available at the front desk.
entries.zh: 前台提供保管箱服务。

entries.en: Hang the do-not-disturb sign on the door if you are on a call.
entries.zh: 如果正在打电话，请在门上挂上请勿打扰标牌。

entries.en: Passengers on the delayed flight will receive a meal-voucher.
entries.zh: 延误航班的乘客将获得餐券。

entries.en: The airline issued a hotel-voucher after the last flight was cancelled.
entries.zh: 末班航班取消后，航空公司开具了酒店凭证。

entries.en: A city-tax is added to the room rate and shown on the final bill.
entries.zh: 房价外另收城市税，并显示在最终账单上。

entries.en: Please leave your name-card with the receptionist.
entries.zh: 请把名片留给前台。

entries.en: I will give you my business-card after the meeting.
entries.zh: 会后我会把名片给你。

entries.en: An updated organization-chart is posted on the intranet.
entries.zh: 更新后的组织架构图已发布在内网上。

entries.en: The probation-period for this role is three months.
entries.zh: 该职位的试用期为三个月。

entries.en: You can download this month's pay-stub from the HR portal.
entries.zh: 你可以从人力资源门户下载本月工资条。

entries.en: Please check your payslip if the overtime hours look incorrect.
entries.zh: 如果加班工时看起来不对，请核对工资单。

entries.en: A travel-claim must be accompanied by original receipts.
entries.zh: 差旅报销申请必须附上收据原件。

entries.en: The staff-canteen will stay open until eight during the inventory.
entries.zh: 盘点期间员工食堂将营业至八点。

entries.en: Please report the spill to the shift-supervisor immediately.
entries.zh: 请立即向班次主管报告泄漏情况。

entries.en: The night-manager is responsible for the lobby after 10 p.m.
entries.zh: 晚上10点后，大厅由夜班经理负责。

entries.en: Please return the key-card to the front-office when you check out.
entries.zh: 退房时请把房卡交还前台。

entries.en: The contract must be approved by head-office before we sign.
entries.zh: 合同在签字前必须获得总部批准。

entries.en: A branch-office will open in the business district next spring.
entries.zh: 明年春天将在商业区开设分公司。

entries.en: Additional staff will be assigned to the sales-floor on Saturday.
entries.zh: 周六将向卖场增派人手。

entries.en: Please return unsold items to the stock-room after closing.
entries.zh: 打烊后请把未售出的商品退回库房。

entries.en: Each fitting-room should be checked for left-behind items every hour.
entries.zh: 每间试衣间应每小时检查是否有顾客遗留物品。

entries.en: The hotel gift-shop is open until 9 p.m. for late arrivals.
entries.zh: 酒店礼品店营业至晚上9点，方便晚到的客人。

entries.en: Please leave large suitcases at the bell-desk if your room is not ready.
entries.zh: 如果房间还没准备好，请把大手提箱寄存在行李服务台。

entries.en: Valet-parking is available at the main entrance of the conference hotel.
entries.zh: 会议酒店正门提供代客泊车。

entries.en: Please book a meeting-room for twelve people on Thursday morning.
entries.zh: 请预订周四上午一间可坐十二人的会议室。

entries.en: Visitors may purchase a day-pass for the staff cafeteria.
entries.zh: 访客可购买员工食堂的日票。
